verses.t: Wodala ndi munthu amene satsata uphungu wa anthu oyipa, kapena kuyimirira pa njira ya anthu ochimwa, kapena kukhala pansi pamodzi ndi anyodozi.
Koma iwo amakondwera mu malamulo a Yehova, ndipo amalingalira malamulo akewo usana ndi usiku.
Iwo ali ngati mtengo wobzalidwa pamphepete pa mtsinje, womwe umabala chipatso pa nyengo yake, ndipo masamba ake samafota. Chilichonse chimene amachita chimapindula.
Koma anthu oyipa siŵali chonchi! Iwo ali ngati mungu wopepuka umene mphepo imauluzira.
Iwo sadzayima pa chiweruzo. Anthu ochimwa sadzakhala pamodzi ndi olungama.
Pakuti Yehova amayang'anira njira ya olungama, koma njira ya oyipa idzapita ku chiwonongeko.
N'chifukwa chiyani mitundu ya anthu ikupanduka? N'chifukwa chiyani mitundu ya anthu ikukonzekera zopanda pake?
Mafumu a dziko lapansi akukonzekera nkhondo; olamulira akusonkhana pamodzi kuti aukire Yehova ndi wodzozedwa wakeyo.
Iwo akuti, "Tiyeni timasule maunyolo awo, ndi kutaya zingwe zawo!"
Koma amene amakhala kumwamba akuseka. Ambuye akuwanyoza.
Kenako amayankhula nawo ali wokwiya, ndipo mkwiyo wake umawachititsa mantha ndi kuti,
"Ndaika mfumu yanga pa Ziyoni, phiri langa loyera."
Mfumu ikulengeza zomwe Yehova ananena: Iye anandiuza kuti, "Iwe ndiwe mwana wanga. Lero ndakhala bambo wako.
Pempha ndipo ndidzakupatsa mitundu ya anthu kuti ikhale cholowa chako, ndi malekezero a dziko lapansi kuti akhale akoako.
Udzawalamulira ndi ndodo yachitsulo; udzawaphwanya ngati mphika wa dothi."
Tsono inu mafumu, chenjerani! Phunzirani inu olamulira a dziko lapansi.
Tumikirani Yehova ndi mantha, ndi kukondwera ndi kunjenjemera.
Gonjerani mwana wake, kuti angakwiye, ndipo mudzawonongeka pa njira yanu, pakuti mkwiyo wake utha kuyaka mosachedwa. Koma odala ndi onse amene amapeza chitetezo mwa iye!
Yehova, ndi anthu ochuluka chotani amene andiukira! Ochuluka ndi amene akundiukira.
Ochuluka akundinena kuti, "Mulungu sadzamupulumutsa." Sela.
Koma inu Yehova ndinu chishango chonditeteza, ulemerero wanga, ndi amene mumandikweza mutu wanga.
Ndimafuula kwa Yehova, ndipo iye amandiyankha kuchokera pa phiri lake loyera. Sela.
Ndinagona pansi ndi kugona tulo; ndinadzuka mwamtendere, pakuti Yehova akundisamalira.
Sindichita mantha ndi anthu masauzande makumi amene andizinga mbali zonse.
Dzukani, Yehova! Pulumutseni, Mulungu wanga! Mwamenya adani anga onse pa nsagwada; mwathyola mano a anthu oyipa.
Chipulumutso chimachokera kwa Yehova. Madalitso anu akhale pa anthu anu. Sela.
Ndiyankheni pamene ndikufuula, Mulungu amene mumandilungamitsa! Munandichotsa m'masautso anga; chitireni chifundo, ndipo mverani pemphero langa.
Inu anthu, ulemerero wanga udzasandulika manyazi mpaka liti? Mukondabe zopanda pake ndi kufuna mabodza? Sela.
Mudziwe kuti Yehova wadzipatulira okhulupirika ake. Yehova adzandimva pamene ndimuyitana.
Munganjenjemere ndi mkwiyo, koma musachimwe. Ganizirani usiku wonse muli atulo, ndipo khalani chete. Sela.
Perekani nsembe zoyenera, ndipo dalirani Yehova.
Ambiri akuti, "Adzationetsera ndani zinthu zabwino?" Yehova, kuwala kwa nkhope yanu kutiwalitsire.
Mwapereka chimwemwe chachikulu mu mtima wanga, choposa chimwemwe cha amene tirigu wawo ndi vinyo wawo zachuluka.
Ndidzagona pansi ndi kugona tulo mwamtendere, pakuti inu nokha, Yehova, mumandichititsa kuti ndikhale motetezeka.
Yehova, mverani mawu anga; ganizirani kubuula kwanga.
Mverani kufuula kwanga, mfumu yanga ndi Mulungu wanga, pakuti ndipemphera kwa inu nokha.
Yehova, mumamva mawu anga m'mawa; m'mawa ndimakubweretserani zopempha zanga ndi kuyembekezera.
Pakuti inu simuli Mulungu wokondwera ndi zoyipa; oyipa sangakhale mu pamaso panu.
Anthu odzitukumula sayima pamaso panu, pakuti mumadana ndi onse ochita zoyipa.
Mudzawononga onse onena mabodza. Yehova amayipidwa ndi anthu opha anzawo ndi onyenga.
Koma chifukwa cha chikondi chanu chosatha, ndidzalowa m'nyumba yanu; ndidzalambira pa kachisi wanu woyera ndi kuopa kwakukulu.
Nditsogolereni, Yehova, mu chilungamo chanu, chifukwa cha adani anga; lungamitsani njira yanu pamaso panga.
Pakuti adani anga sangadalirike. Mitima yawo ndi yodzaza ndi chiwonongeko. Pakamwa pawo pali mabodza okha; m'mawu awo muli matemberero.
Aweruzeni, Mulungu! Aleke kuti agonjetsedwe ndi mapulani awo. Awachosereni chifukwa cha machimo awo ambiri, pakuti apandukira inu.
Koma onse amene amathawira kwa inu akondwere; nyimbo zachimwemwe zikhale pa milomo yawo nthawi zonse, pakuti inu mumawateteza. Onse amene amakonda dzina lanu akondwerere mwa inu.
Pakuti inu Yehova mumadalitsa olungama; mumawazungulira ndi chisomo chanu ngati chishango chachikulu.
Yehova, musandidzudzule mukukwiya; musandilange mu mkwiyo wanu.
Chitireni chifundo, Yehova, pakuti ndafooka kwambiri. Ndichiritseni, Yehova, pakuti mafupa anga akupweteka.
Moyo wanga uli mu masautso. Yehova, mpaka liti?
Bweraninso, Yehova, ndipo pulumutsani moyo wanga; ndipulumutseni chifukwa cha chikondi chanu chosatha.
Pakuti mwa imfa palibe amene amakukumbukirani. Mu manda angakutamandeni ndani?
Ndatopa ndi kubuula. Usiku wonse pogona panga ndi pochuka ndi misozi; mphasa yanga yanyowa ndi misozi.
Maso anga abundirira ndi chisoni; akufooka chifukwa cha adani anga onse.
Chokani kwa ine, inu nonse ochita zoyipa, pakuti Yehova wamva kulira kwanga.
Yehova wamva pempho langa; Yehova adzandiyankha pemphero langa.
Adani anga onse adzachita manyazi ndi kusokonezeka kwambiri; iwo adzabwerera mwadzidzidzi mwamanyazi.
Yehova Mulungu wanga, ndimathawira mwa inu. Ndipulumutseni kwa onse amene akundithamangitsa, ndipo ndilanditseni!
Apo ayi adzandikwakwathula ngati mkango; adzandidya popanda wina wondipulumutsa.
Yehova Mulungu wanga, ngati ndachita ichi—ngati ndili ndi mlandu pa manja anga,
ngati ndalipira choyipa kwa amene ali pa mtendere ndi ine, kapena ngati ndalanda mdani wanga popanda chifukwa,
ndiye lekani mdani wanga andithamangitse ndi kundigwira; lekani anditsapule pansi ndi kuyika ulemerero wanga mu fumbi. Sela.
Dzukani, Yehova, mu mkwiyo wanu! Imani motsutsana ndi ukali wa adani anga! Dzukani, Mulungu wanga, ndipo perekani chiweruzo!
Sonkhanitsani mitundu ya anthu kuzungulira inu. Lamulireni kuchokera kumwamba.
Yehova amaweruza mitundu ya anthu. Ndiweruzeni, Yehova, mogwirizana ndi chilungamo changa, mogwirizana ndi kukhulupirika kwanga, Wamkuludzukulu.
Thetsani zoyipa za anthu oyipa, ndipo kwezeni olungama, pakuti inu Mulungu wolungama mumayang'ana mtima ndi maganizo.
Mulungu ndiye chishango changa, amene amapulumutsa anthu olungama mu mtima.
Mulungu ndi woweruza wolungama, Mulungu wokwiya ndi anthu oyipa tsiku lililonse.
Ngati munthu sasintha mtima wake, Mulungu adzanola lupanga lake; adzakoka ndi kukonza uta wake.
Wakonzeratu zida zake zoopsa; akonzeretu mivi yake yoyaka moto.
Onani munthu woyipa amene akubereka zoyipa, woyamba kupanga vuto, ndipo amabereka mabodza.
Iwo akumba dzenje ndi kulizamitsa, koma adzagweramo iwowo.
Mavuto amene amakonzera ena adzabwerera kwa iwowo; nkhanza zawo zidzagwera pa mitu yawoyo.
Ndidzayamika Yehova chifukwa cha chilungamo chake; ndidzayimba zatamando dzina la Yehova Wamkuludzukulu.
Yehova, Ambuye wathu, ulemerero wa dzina lanu ndi waukulu chotani mu dziko lonse lapansi! Mwaika ulemerero wanu pamwamba pa kumwamba kwambiri.
Mwakhazikitsa nyumba yamphamvu kuchokera m'pakamwa pa makanda ndi ana akhanda kuti achilitsire adani anu, kuthetsa adani ndi obwezera.
Pamene ndipenya kumwamba kwanu, ntchito ya zala zanu, mwezi ndi nyenyezi zomwe munazika m'malo mwawo,
ndimadzifunsa kuti, munthu ndani kuti mumukumbukire, mwana wa munthu kuti mumusamalire?
Komabe munamupanga pansi pang'ono kwa angelo; munamuveka korona ndi ulemerero ndi ulemu.
Munamupatsa ulamuliro pa zonse zomwe munazipanga; munaika zinthu zonse pansi pa mapazi ake—
ng'ombe ndi nkhosa zonse, ndi nyama zakuthengo,
mbalame zakumlengalenga, nsomba zakunyanja, ndi zonse zoyenda m'madzi.
Yehova, Ambuye wathu, ulemerero wa dzina lanu ndi waukulu chotani mu dziko lonse lapansi!
Ndidzayamika Yehova ndi mtima wanga wonse; ndidzasimba zinthu zonse zodabwitsa zomwe mwachita.
Ndidzakondwera ndi kudzaza ndi chimwemwe chifukwa cha inu. Ndidzayimba nyimbo za matamando dzina lanu, Wamkuludzukulu.
Adani anga abwerera; iwo agwa ndi kuwonongeka pamaso panu.
Pakuti mwagamula ndi kuteteza ufulu wanga; mwakhala pa mpando wanu wachifumu, woweruza molungama.
Mwadzudzula mitundu ya anthu ndi kuwononga oyipa; mwafafaniza dzina lawo kosatha.
Adani athu agonjetsedwa kwathunthu mpaka kalekale. Mwakwiritsa midzi yawo; sadzakumbukika.
Koma Yehova alamulira mpaka kalekale; wakonza mpando wake wachifumu woweruzira.
Adzaweruza dziko lapansi mwa chilungamo; adzalamulira mitundu ya anthu mwachoonadi.
Yehova ndi pothawira pa anthu osautsidwa, pothawira nthawi ya masautso.
Onse amene amadziwa dzina lanu adzakhulupirira inu, pakuti inu Yehova simusiya amene amakufunafunani.
Imbirani Yehova matamando, amene amalamulira ku Yerusalemu. Lengezani pakati pa mitundu ya anthu zomwe iye wachita.
Pakuti amene amabwezera magazi otayidwa amakumbukira; samanyalanyaza kufuula kwa amene akuvutika.
Yehova, chitireni chifundo. Onani momwe akundizunzira adani anga. Ndichotseni pa zipata za imfa,
kuti ndilengeze matamando anu onse pa zipata za Yerusalemu, ndi kukondwerera chipulumutso chanu.
Mitundu ya anthu yagweramo m'dzenje limene anakumba; mapazi awo akodwa mu ukonde umene anabisa.
Yehova adziwika ndi chiweruzo chake; oyipa akodwa ndi ntchito za manja awoawo. Higayoni. Sela.
Anthu oyipa adzapita ku manda, pamodzi ndi mitundu yonse imene imayiwala Mulungu.
Koma osowa sadzayiwalika kosatha; chiyembekezo cha osautsika sichidzapita pachabe.
Dzukani, Yehova! Musalole anthu kuti agonjetse! Lekani aweruzidwe pamaso panu.
Apatseni mantha, Yehova; lekani mitundu idziwe kuti ndi anthu chabe. Sela.
Yehova, n'chifukwa chiyani muli kutali? N'chifukwa chiyani mumadzibisa nthawi ya masautso?
Anthu oyipa akumuthamangitsa wovutika modzitukumula; akodweretu m'mapulani amene apanga.
Pakuti munthu woyipa amadzitamandira chifukwa cha zilakolako za mtima wake; amadalitsa anthu osusuka ndi kunyoza Yehova.
Mwa kunyada kwawo, anthu oyipa safuna kufunafuna Mulungu. Maganizo awo onse alibe malo a Mulungu.
Komabe zinthu zawo zimayenda bwino; sazindikira chiweruzo chanu chofika kutali; amanyodola adani awo onse.
Iwo akudzinena mu mtima mwawo kuti, "Sitidzagwedezeka. Mibadwomibadwo sitidzaona masautso."
M'kamwa mwawo muli matemberero, mabodza ndi ziwopsezo; mavuto ndi zoyipa zili pansi pa lilime lawo.
Amabisalira mafano m'mudzi; amapha munthu wamasiye mwabisi; amayang'anira anthu opanda mphamvu.
Iwo abisala ngati mkango m'tchire; abisala kuti agwire osautsika; amagwira osautsika ndi kumukokera m'khwekwe lawo.
Wovutika amaphwanyidwa ndi kugonjetsedwa; amagwa pansi ndi mphamvu yawo.
Munthu woyipa amaganiza mu mtima mwake kuti, "Mulungu wandiyiwala! Wabisa nkhope yake; sadzaona ngakhale pang'ono."
Dzukani, Yehova! Yang'anani, Mulungu! Musayiwale anthu opanda mphamvu.
N'chifukwa chiyani anthu oyipa amanyoza Mulungu? N'chifukwa chiyani amadziwuza mu mtima mwawo kuti, "Sadzatifunsa ndi pang'ono pomwe"?
Koma inu mukuona vuto ndi chisoni; mumayang'anira ndi kuchitirapo kanthu. Wovutika adziika pa inu nokha; ndinu thandizo la wamasiye.
Thyolani mphamvu ya munthu woyipa ndi wachisawawa; pemphani mlandu wa zoyipa zawo zonse mpaka palibe yotsala.
Yehova ndi mfumu kosatha ndi kosatha! Mitundu ya anthu idzachoka m'dziko lake.
Yehova, mukudziwa zofuna za osautsika; mudzalimbikitsa mitima yawo ndi kumvetsera pemphero lawo.
Mudzaweruza mlandu wa wamasiye ndi wopondereza, kuti munthu wa pa dziko lapansi asapitirize kuopseza ena.
Ndimathawira mwa Yehova. Tsono mungandinene chotani kuti ndithawe ku phiri ngati mbalame?
Anthu oyipa akukoka uta wawo; akukonzera mivi yawo pa zingwe kuti aponye mu mdima pa anthu olungama mu mtima.
Maziko akagwetsedwa, kodi olungama angachite chiyani?
Koma Yehova ali mu kachisi wake woyera; Yehova akhalabe pa mpando wake wachifumu kumwamba. Amayang'anitsitsa za onse, amayesa mtima wa munthu aliyense.
Yehova amayesa olungama, koma amadana ndi anthu oyipa ndi amene amakonda chiwawa.
Iye adzagwetsa malasha oyaka moto ndi sulufule pa anthu oyipa, ndi mphepo yotentha kwambiri idzakhala chigawo chawo.
Pakuti Yehova ndi wolungama, amakonda chilungamo. Anthu olungama adzaona nkhope yake.
Pulumutseni, Yehova! Anthu okhulupirika atha; okhulupirika asowa pa anthu.
Aliyense amabodzera mnzake; amayankhula ndi milomo yonyengera ndi mtima wokayikira.
Yehova adule milomo yonse yonyengera ndi malilime onse odzitamanda.
Anena kuti, "Tidzapambana ndi malirime athu. Tilankhula momwe tikufunira—amene angatilamulire?"
Yehova akuti, "Chifukwa cha kuponderezedwa kwa anthu opanda mphamvu, ndi kubuula kwa osauka, tsopano ndidzauka. Ndidzawapulumutsa kwa amene amawanyoza."
Mawu a Yehova ndi oyera, oyengedwa ngati siliva mu ng'anjo, oyengedwa kasanu ndi kawiri.
Yehova, mudzasunga osautsika; mudzawateteza kwa anthu oyipa kosatha,
ngakhale anthu oyipa akuyenda mbali zonse, ndi zoyipa zikuyamikidwa pakati pa anthu.
Mpaka liti, Yehova? Mudzandiyiwala mpaka kalekale? Mpaka liti mudzabisa nkhope yanu kwa ine?
Mpaka liti ndizovutika ndi nkhawa, ndi chisoni mu mtima mwanga tsiku lililonse? Mpaka liti mdani wanga adzandipambana?
Yang'anani ndi kundiyankha, Yehova Mulungu wanga. Ndiwalitsireni m'maso, kuti ndisagone tulo ta imfa,
kuti mdani wanga asanene kuti, "Ndamupambana," ndi kuti opondereza anga asakondwere ndikadzigwa.
Koma ine ndimadalira chikondi chanu chosatha; mtima wanga udzakondwera mu chipulumutso chanu.
Ndidzayimbira Yehova nyimbo, pakuti wandichitira zabwino.
Opusa amanena mu mtima mwawo kuti, "Palibe Mulungu." Iwo ndi oyipa, ndipo ntchito zawo ndi zonyansa; palibe wochita zabwino.
Yehova akuyang'ana pansi kuchokera kumwamba pa anthu, kuti aone ngati alipo wozindikira, alionse ofuna Mulungu.
Koma onse atembenuka; onse asanduka oyipa pamodzi. Palibe ngakhale m'modzi yemwe amachita zabwino, ngakhale m'modzi.
Kodi ochita zoyipa onsewa sazindikira? Iwo amadya anthu anga ngati momwe amadyera buledi, ndi sayitana Yehova.
Koma chimuopsa chidzawagwera, pakuti Mulungu ali pakati pa olungama.
Anthu oyipa amaseka mapulani a osautsika, koma Yehova adzawateteza.
Ndani adzapereka chipulumutso ku Yerusalemu chifukwa cha Aisraeli? Pamene Yehova adzabwezeretsanso anthu ake, Yakobo adzakondwera ndi Aisraeli adzasangalala.
Yehova, ndani angakhale mu kachisi wanu? Ndani angakhale pa phiri lanu loyera?
Amene amayenda mosaipa ndi kuchita zolungama, ndi amene amalankhula choonadi mu mtima mwake;
amene salankhula mwambo ndi lilime lake, ndi sachita choyipa kwa mnzake, ndi salankhula zonyoza za mnzake;
amene amanyoza woyipa, koma amalemekeza amene amaopa Yehova; amene amalonjeza ndi kusunga ngakhale zikamupweteka;
amene amapereka ndalama yake popanda chiwongolero, ndi salandira ziphuphu kuti azinena anthu osalakwa. Munthu wochita zonsezi sadzagwedezeka.
Nditetezeni, Mulungu, pakuti ndimathawira mwa inu.
Ndinati kwa Yehova, "Inu ndinu Ambuye wanga; zonse zabwino zomwe ndimadalira zimachokera kwa inu."
Anthu oyera amene ali m'dziko ndi olemekezeka; chimwemwe changa chonse chili mwa iwo.
Vuto la amene amathamangira milungu ina lidzachuluka. Sindidzapereka nsembe za magazi kwa milungu yotereyo, kapena kutchula mayina awo pa milomo yanga.
Yehova ndiye chigawo changa ndi chikho changa cha madalitso; mumandisunga zonse zomwe ndili nazo.
Mwanga unagweramo m'malo abwino; ndinalandira cholowa chokondwetsa.
Ndidzatamanda Yehova amene amandilangiza; ngakhale usiku mtima wanga umandiphunzitsa.
Ndimaika Yehova patsogolo panga nthawi zonse. Pakuti ali kudzanja langa lamanja, sindidzagwedezeka.
Choncho mtima wanga ukukondwera, ulemerero wanga ukukondwerera, ndipo thupi langa lipuma motetezeka.
Pakuti simudzasiya moyo wanga m'manda, kapena kulola woyera wanu kuwola.
Mudzandisonyeza njira ya moyo, kudzaza kwa chimwemwe pamaso panu, ndi zosangalatsa zosatha kudzanja lanu lamanja.
Yehova, mverani pempho langa la chilungamo. Mverani kufuula kwanga kwa thandizo. Tcherani makutu kwa pemphero langa, lochokera mu milomo yopanda chinyengo.
Chiweruzo changa chichoke kwa inu; maso anu aone choonadi.
Mwayesa mtima wanga; mwandiyendera usiku. Mwandiyesa, ndipo simunapeze cholakwa. Ndatsimikiza kuti m'kamwa mwanga musaipe.
Pa zochita za anthu, ndatsatira mawu a milomo yanu, ndipo ndapewa njira za achiwawa.
Mapazi anga akhalabe pa njira zanu; mapazi anga sanagwedezeke.
Ndikuyitanani, Mulungu, chifukwa mudzandiyankha. Tcherani khutu lanu kwa ine; mverani mawu anga.
Sonyezani chikondi chanu chosatha modabwitsa, inu Mpulumutsi wa amene akuthawira mwa inu kwa adani awo.
Ndisungeni ngati mwanawanjano wa diso lanu; ndibiseni mu mthunzi wa mapiko anu
kwa anthu oyipa amene andiukira, kwa adani anga akupha amene azinga ine mbali zonse.
Iwo atseka mitima yawo yopanda chifundo; pakamwa pawo akuyankhula modzitukumula.
Atilondola; tsopano andizinga; akufunafuna mwa yi kundigwetsa pansi.
Iwo ali ngati mkango wanjala wa nyama, ngati mkango waukulu obisalira mu mdima.
Dzukani, Yehova! Yimani motsutsana nawo, ndipo agwetseni! Ndipulumutseni kwa anthu oyipa ndi lupanga lanu.
Ndi mphamvu zanu pulumutseni ine kwa anthu, Yehova—kwa anthu amene ali ndi mbali yawo m'moyo uno. Koma kuwadyetsa amene mumawakonda; ana awo akhuta, ndipo amasiya zinthu zambiri kwa ana awo.
Koma chifukwa ndine wolungama, ndidzaona nkhope yanu. Ndikadzadzuka, ndidzakhutitsidwa kwambiri pakuti ndidzaona nkhope yanu.
Ndimakukondani, Yehova, mphamvu yanga.
Yehova ndiye thanthwe langa, linga langa ndi mpulumutsi wanga; Mulungu wanga, thanthwe langa, kumene ndimathawira; chishango changa, mphamvu ya chipulumutso changa, ndi pothawira panga.
Ndimayitana Yehova, woyenera kutamandidwa, ndipo ndimapulumutsidwa kwa adani anga.
Mphamvu za imfa zinandizungulira; mafunde a chiwonongeko anandigwetsa.
Mphete za manda zinandimangirira; misampha ya imfa inadzaza pa njira yanga.
Mu masautso anga ndinayitana Yehova; ndinafuula kwa Mulungu wanga kuti andithandize. Iye anamva mawu anga kuchokera mu kachisi wake; kufuula kwanga kunafika m'makutu mwake.
Pamenepo dziko lapansi linagwedezeka; maziko a mapiri ananjenjemera; ananjenjemera chifukwa anakwiya.
Utsi unatuluka m'mphuno mwake; moto unatuluka m'kamwa mwake; malasha oyaka anatuluka mwa iye.
Anatsegula kumwamba ndi kutsika; pansi pa mapazi ake panali mitambo ya mdima.
Anakwera pa kerubi ndi kuwuluka; anauluka pa mapiko a mphepo.
Anavala mdima monga chofunda chake; mtambo wa mvula ndi mitambo yakuda zinamuzinga.
Kuwala kwakukulu kunaonekera pamaso pake; matalala ndi malasha oyaka zinatsika.
Yehova anabangula kuchokera kumwamba; mawu a Wamkuludzukulu anamveka kupyoletsa matalala ndi malasha oyaka.
Anaponya mivi yake ndi kuwabalalitsa adani; chingwe cha mphenzi chinawasokoneza.
Pamenepo malo otsika a nyanja anaonekera, ndi maziko a dziko lapansi anavundukulidwa pamene Yehova anadzudzula, polavula mphepo m'mphuno mwake.
Iye anatambasula dzanja kuchokera kumwamba ndi kundigwira; anandichotsa m'madzi akuya.
Anandipulumutsa kwa mdani wanga wamphamvu, kwa amene ankandida, amene anali olimba kwambiri kwa ine.
Iwo anandiukira pa tsiku la masautso, koma Yehova anandigwiriza.
Anandikoka m'malo otambalala; anandipulumutsa chifukwa anakondwera nane.
Yehova anandilipira chifukwa cha kulungama kwanga; chifukwa cha kuyera kwa manja anga anandipatsa mphotho.
Pakuti ndatsata njira za Yehova; sindinapandukire Mulungu wanga.
Malamulo ake onse ali patsogolo panga; sindinatembenukire kwina kwa malamulo ake.
Ndakhala wopanda chilema pamaso pake, ndipo ndadzitchinjiriza ku tchimo.
Yehova andilipira chifukwa cha kulungama kwanga, chifukwa cha kuyera kwa manja anga pamaso pake.
Kwa okhulupirika mukhala wokhulupirika; kwa olungama mukhala wolungama.
Kwa oyera mukhala woyera, koma kwa onyenga mumaonetsa mphamvu yanu.
Mumapulumutsa odzichepetsa, koma mumagwetsa odzitukumula.
Mumayatsa nyale yanga; Yehova Mulungu wanga amaunikira mdima wanga.
Ndi thandizo lanu ndingaukire gulu la asilikali; ndi Mulungu wanga ndingadumphire khoma.
Njira ya Mulungu ndi yangwiro. Lonjezo la Yehova layesedwa. Iye ndi chishango kwa onse omwe amathawira mwa iye.
Pakuti ndani ali Mulungu kupatula Yehova? Ndani ndiye thanthwe kupatula Mulungu wathu?
Mulungu ndiye amene amandipatsa mphamvu, ndi kupanga njira yanga yopanda chilema.
Amapanga mapazi anga kukhala otsika ngati a mbawala; amandiyimika pa malo okwera.
Amaphunzitsa manja anga kuti amenye nkhondo; manja anga angakoke uta wamkuwa.
Mwandipatsa chishango cha chipulumutso chanu; dzanja lanu lamanja landigwiriza, ndi kudzichepetsa kwanu kwandichititsa kukhala wamkulu.
Mwakulitsa malo a mapazi anga, kuti akakolopa anga asakhumudwe.
Ndinathamangitsa adani anga ndi kuwapeza; sindinabwerere mpaka anatha.
Ndinawamenya kuti sanathenso kuyimirira; anagwa pansi pa mapazi anga.
Mwandipatsa mphamvu pa nkhondo; mwagwetsa adani anga pansi pa mapazi anga.
Mwapereka mapewa a adani anga ku ine; ndinawononga amene amandida.
Anafuula kuti athandizidwe, koma palibe amene anabwera kudzawapulumutsa; ngakhale kwa Yehova, koma sanawayankhe.
Ndinawapera ngati fumbi loulutsidwa ndi mphepo; ndinawatsanulira pansi ngati matope a m'misewu.
Mwandipulumutsa kwa anthu opanduka; mwandiika kuti ndilamulire mitundu. Anthu amene sindinkawadziwa akunditumikira.
Akumva za ine, ndipo amandimvera; alendo amabwera kwa ine modzichepetsa.
Iwo onse afooka; abwera akunjenjemera kuchokera m'malo awo otetezeka.
Yehova ali moyo! Akudalitsidwe Thanthwe langa! Akukwezeke Mulungu wa chipulumutso changa!
Iye ndiye Mulungu amene amandibwezera, ndi kugonjetsa anthu pansi panga.
ndi kundipulumutsa kwa adani anga. Mwandikweza pamwamba pa adani anga; mwandipulumutsa kwa anthu achiwawa.
Choncho ndidzakutamandani, Yehova, pakati pa mitundu; ndidzayimba zatamando dzina lanu.
Mumapereka chigonjetso chachikulu kwa mfumu yanu; mumasonyeza chikondi chosasinthika kwa wodzozedwa wanu, kwa Davide ndi mbumba yake kwamuyaya.
Kumwamba kumalengeza ulemerero wa Mulungu; thambo limaonetsa luso la manja ake.
Tsiku ndi tsiku akumalankhula; usiku ndi usiku akumaonetsa nzeru.
Akulankhula popanda mawu kapena liwu; mawu awo samveka.
Komabe uthenga wawo wapita ku dziko lonse lapansi; mawu awo afika kumalekezero a dziko. Mulungu anaika thambo lokhalamo dzuwa.
Limatuluka ngati mkwati wotuluka m'chipinda chake, ngati katswiri wothamanga wokondwera kuchita ulendo wake.
Limatuluka kumapeto a kumwamba ndi kuzungulira mpaka kwina kumeneko; palibe chimene chimabisika ku kutentha kwake.
Lamulo la Yehova ndi langwiro, lopukuta moyo; mawu a Yehova ndi okhulupirika, opereka nzeru kwa wopanda nzeru.
Malangizo a Yehova ndi olungama, kukondweretsa mtima; malamulo a Yehova ndi oyera, kuwalitsa maso.
Kuopa Yehova ndi koyera, kokhalitsa kosatha. Maweruzo a Yehova ndi oona ndi olungama kwathunthu.
Ali okondweretsa kuposa golidi, ngakhale kuposa golidi woyengeka; otsekemera kuposa uchi, kuposa uchi woti otola pa chisa.
Amachenjezanso mtumiki wanu; pomvera kuli mphotho yayikulu.
Ndani angadziwe zolakwa zake? Ndichotsereni zolakwa zanga zobisika.
Ndisungeni kutchimo lodzitukumula; lisalamulire ine. Ndiye ndidzakhala wopanda chilema, wosalakwa pa cholakwa chachikulu.
Mawu a m'kamwa mwanga ndi maganizo a mtima wanga zikuyenererani, Yehova, thanthwe langa ndi mpulumutsi wanga.
Yehova akuyankheni nthawi ya masautso; dzina la Mulungu wa Yakobo likutetezeni.
Akutumizireni thandizo kuchokera ku kachisi wake; akupatseni mphamvu kuchokera ku Ziyoni.
Akumbukire nsembe zanu zonse, ndi kulandira nsembe zanu zopsereza. Sela.
Akupatseni zofuna za mtima wanu, ndi kukwaniritsa mapulani anu onse.
Tikondwerere chigonjetso chanu, ndi kuyimika mbendera mu dzina la Mulungu wathu. Yehova akwaniritse zonse mwapempha.
Tsopano ndikudziwa kuti Yehova amapulumutsa wodzozedwa wake; amamuyankha kuchokera kumwamba kwake koyera ndi mphamvu yopulumutsa ya dzanja lake lamanja.
Ena amadalira magaleta ndi akavalo, koma ife timadalira dzina la Yehova Mulungu wathu.
Iwo agwedezeka ndi kugwa, koma ife taima molimba.
Pulumutsani mfumu, Yehova! Tiyankheni tikufuula!
Yehova, mfumu ikukondwera mu mphamvu yanu. Ikuyimba ndi chimwemwe pa chipulumutso chanu.
Mwapereka kwa mfumu chifuniro cha mtima wake; simunamane kupempha kwa milomo yake. Sela.
Munamulandira ndi madalitso ambiri, ndi kumuyika korona ya golidi woyengeka pa mutu wake.
Anapempha moyo, ndipo munam'patsa—moyo wautali, kosatha ndi kosatha.
Ulemerero wake ndi waukulu chifukwa cha chipulumutso chanu. Mwam'patsa ulemerero ndi ulemu.
Mwam'patsa madalitso a kosatha; mwamukondweretsa ndi chimwemwe pamaso panu.
Pakuti mfumu imadalira Yehova; chifukwa cha chikondi chosasinthika cha Wamkuludzukulu, sidzagwa.
Dzanja lanu lidzapeza adani anu onse; dzanja lanu lamanja lidzapeza onse okudani.
Pamene mudzaonekera, mudzawayatsa ngati ng'anjo. Yehova adzawawononga mu mkwiyo wake; moto udzawawononga.
Mudzafafaniza ana awo pa dziko lapansi; zidzukulu zawo sizidzakhalapo pakati pa anthu.
Ngakhale ankakonzera zoyipa zotsutsa inu, mapulani awo oyipa sangakwaniritse.
Mudzawasandutsa kuti athawe pamene mudzakoke uta wanu kwa iwo.
Khalani okwezeka, Yehova, mu mphamvu yanu! Tidzayimba ndi kuimika nyimbo zatamando za luso lanu.
Mulungu wanga, Mulungu wanga, n'chifukwa chiyani mwandisiya? N'chifukwa chiyani muli kutali, osandipulumutsa, kutali ndi mawu a kufuula kwanga?
Mulungu wanga, ndimafuula masana, koma simumayankha; usiku, ndipo sindipeza mpumulo.
Komabe inu ndinu woyera, mukukhala pa mpando wa matamando a Aisraeli.
Makolo athu anakhulupirira inu; anakhulupirira ndipo munawapulumutsa.
Anafuula kwa inu ndipo anapulumutsidwa; anakhulupirira inu ndipo sanachite manyazi.
Koma ine ndine nyongolotsi osati munthu, wonyozedwa ndi anthu, wodedwa ndi anthu.
Aliyense amene amandiona amandinyoza; amapukuta milomo yawo ndi kupukusa mitu yawo, akuti,
"Adziika pa Yehova! Yehova adzamupulumutsa! Adzamulanditsa, popeza akumukondwera, sichoncho?"
Komabe ndinu amene munandichotsa mu chiberekero changa, kundisamalira ndili pa bere la amayi anga.
Ndinaponyedwera pa inu kuyambira pamene ndinabadwa; mwakhala Mulungu wanga kuyambira ndili m'mimba mwa amayi anga.
Musakhale kutali ndi ine, pakuti masautso ali pafupi, ndipo palibe wina wothandiza.
Adani anga andizinga ngati ng'ombe zazimuna; ng'ombe zamphamvu za ku Basana zandizungulira.
Atsegula pakamwa pawo ngati mkango wokokomba ndi wofuna kuwononga.
Ndatayika ngati madzi otayidwa, ndi mafupa anga onse achosoka. Mtima wanga wakhala ngati phula; wasungunuka mu thupi langa.
Mphamvu yanga yauma ngati phale la mphika, ndi lilime langa lamatira ku msipa wanga. Mwandiika mu fumbi la imfa.
Agalu andizinga; gulu la oyipa landizungulira. Aboola manja ndi mapazi anga.
Ndingathe kuwerenga mafupa anga onse. Adani anga ali kunditcheya ndi kundipenya.
Akugawana zovala zanga pakati pawo, ndi kuponyera mwala chovala changa.
Yehova, musakhale kutali! Mphamvu yanga, fulumirani kudzanditandiza!
Pulumutsani moyo wanga ku lupanga; moyo wanga wokondedwa kupulumutsani ku mphamvu ya agalu.
Ndilanditseni kupakamwa pa mkango; ndipulumutseni ku nyanga za njati.
Ndidzalengeza dzina lanu kwa abale anga; pakati pa msonkhano ndidzakutamandani.
Inu amene mumaopa Yehova, mutamandeni! Inu nonse a mbumba ya Yakobo, mulemekezeni! Inu nonse a mbumba ya Aisraeli, ngakhale muopeni!
Pakuti sananyoze kapena kunyalanyaza masautso a osautsika; sanabise nkhope yake kwa iye, koma anamvera pamene anafuula kwa iye.
Ndidzakutamandani pakati pa msonkhano waukulu. Ndidzakwaniritsa malumbiro anga pamaso pa amene amaopani.
Osautsika adzadya ndi kukhuta. Onse amene amafunafuna Yehova adzayimika nyimbo zake. Mitima yawo idzasangalala kosatha.
Dziko lonse lapansi lidzakumbukira ndi kubwerera kwa Yehova. Mafuko onse adzapembedza pamaso panu.
Pakuti ulamuliro ndi wa Yehova; iye amalamulira pa mitundu ya anthu.
Olemera padziko lapansi adzapembedza pamaso pake; onse okhala m'fumbi adzagwada pamaso pake—aliyense amene moyo wake umafa.
Ana athu adzamutumikira; mibadwo idzauzidwa za Ambuye.
Adzamuza za chilungamo chake kwa anthu omwe sanabadwe; adzauza za zonse zomwe wachita.
Yehova ndi m'busa wanga; sindidzasowa kanthu.
Amandigoneka m'mabusa abiriwiri; amanditsogolera m'mphepete mwa madzi opumira.
Iye amatsitsimutsa moyo wanga; amanditsogolera m'mabwalo a chilungamo chifukwa cha dzina lake.
Ngakhale ndiyenda mu chigwa cha mthunzi wa imfa, sindidzaopa choyipa, pakuti muli nane; ndodo yanu ndi msempha wanu zimanditonthoza.
Mwakonzera ine phwando pamaso pa adani anga. Mwadzoza mutu wanga ndi mafuta. Chikho changa chasefukira ndi madalitso.
Zoona zabwino ndi chikondi chosasinthika zidzanditsata masiku onse a moyo wanga, ndipo ndidzakhala m'nyumba ya Yehova kosatha.
Dziko lapansi ndi la Yehova, ndi zonse zomwe zilimo, dziko ndi onse okhalamo.
Pakuti analikhazikitsa pa nyanja ndi kulisanjika pa madzi akuya.
Ndani angakwere phiri la Yehova? Ndani angayime mu malo ake oyera?
Yekhayo wamanja oyera ndi mtima woyera; amene saugwiritsa moyo wake ku mafano, amene salumbira mwabodza.
Iwo adzalandira madalitso a Yehova ndi chilungamo cha Mulungu wopulumutsa wawo.
Awa ndiwo a mbadwo amene amafunafuna iye, amene amayang'ana nkhope ya Mulungu wa Yakobo. Sela.
Tukulani mitu yanu, inu zipata; tsegukani, inu mavingo akale, kuti Mfumu ya ulemerero ilowe!
Ndani Mfumu ya ulemerero? Yehova, wamphamvu ndi wachiwawa, Yehova, wamphamvu pa nkhondo.
Tukulani mitu yanu, inu zipata; tsegukani, inu mavingo akale, kuti Mfumu ya ulemerero ilowe!
Ndani Mfumu ya ulemerero? Yehova wa makamu—iye ndiye Mfumu ya ulemerero. Sela.
Yehova, kwa inu ndimaika moyo wanga.
Ndimakhulupirira inu, Mulungu wanga! Musalole kuti ndichite manyazi, kapena adani anga akondwere chifukwa cha ine.
Palibe amene amayembekezera inu adzachita manyazi, koma manyazi adzagwera anthu osasunga lonjezo.
Ndionetseni njira yanu, Yehova; ndiphunzitseni mayendedwe anu.
Nditsogolereni mu choonadi chanu ndi kundiphunzitsa, pakuti ndinu Mulungu wopulumutsa wanga; pa inu ndimakhulupirira tsiku lonse.
Kumbukirani, Yehova, chifundo chanu ndi chikondi chanu chosasinthika, chimene zakhala kuyambira kalekale.
Musakumbukire machimo a chinyamata changa ndi kupanduka kwanga. Mu chikondi chanu chosasinthika, ndikumbukireni, pakuti ndinu wabwino, Yehova.
Yehova ndi wabwino ndi wolungama; chifukwa chake amaphunzitsa ochimwa njira yake.
Iye amatsogolera odzichepetsa molungama ndi kuwaphunzitsa njira yake.
Yehova amatsogolera ndi chikondi chosasinthika ndi kukhulupirika onse osunga pangano lake ndi mawu ake.
Chifukwa cha dzina lanu, Yehova, khululukireni mlandu wanga waukulu.
Ndani amaopa Yehova? Iye adzawaphunzitsa njira yomwe ayenera kusankha.
Adzakhala m'mtendere, ndipo ana awo adzalandira dziko ngati cholowa.
Yehova ndi mbumba kwa amene amamuopa; amaonetsa pangano lake kwa iwo.
Maso anga akuyang'ana Yehova nthawi zonse, pakuti iye yekha akhoza kundipulumutsa mu mphete.
Tembenukirani kwa ine ndi kundichitira chifundo, pakuti ndili ndekha ndi ndavutika.
Mavuto a mtima wanga akuwonjezeka. Ndichotseni m'masautso anga.
Onani masautso anga ndi mavuto anga; khululukireni machimo anga onse.
Onani momwe adani anga akhalira ochuluka, ndi momwe akundinyozera modetsa nkhawa.
Tetezani moyo wanga ndi kundipulumutsa! Ndisachite manyazi, pakuti ndimathawira mwa inu.
Kupanda chinyengo ndi kulungama zindisunge, pakuti ndimadalira inu.
Mulungu, mupulumutse Aisraeli ku mavuto awo onse.
Andiweruzeni, Yehova, pakuti ndakhala wopanda chilema; ndakhulupirira Yehova popanda kugwedezeka.
Ndiyeseni, Yehova, ndi kundifufuza; yesani mtima wanga ndi maganizo anga.
Pakuti chikondi chanu chosasinthika ndi pamaso panga nthawi zonse, ndipo ndimayenda mu choonadi chanu.
Sindimakhala ndi anthu onyenga, kapena ndimayenda ndi onyenga.
Ndimadana ndi msonkhano wa ochita zoyipa; sindimakhala ndi anthu oyipa.
Ndimasamba manja anga mu chiyero kuti ndizungulire guwa lanu lansembe, Yehova,
kuyimba nyimbo zatamando ndi kuuza zonse zodabwitsa zomwe mwachita.
Ndimakonda nyumba yanu, Yehova, malo amene ulemerero wanu umakhala.
Musatsetsereze moyo wanga pamodzi ndi ochimwa, kapena moyo wanga pamodzi ndi anthu opha,
amene mu manja awo muli zoyipa, dzanja lawo lamanja lodzaza ndi ziphuphu.
Koma ine ndakhala wopanda chilema; ndilanditseni ndi kundichitira chifundo.
Tsopano ndayima pa malo abwino. Ndidzayimika nyimbo za Yehova pakati pa msonkhano.
Yehova ndiye kuwala kwanga ndi chipulumutso changa—ndani ndingamuope? Yehova ndiye linga la moyo wanga—pati ndingachite mantha?
Pamene anthu oyipa andiukira kuti adye nyama yanga, pamene adani anga andiukira, iwo adzapunthwa ndi kugwa.
Ngakhale gulu lankhondo lozungulira, mtima wanga sudzaopa; ngakhale nkhondo iukire ine, ngakhale nthawiyo ndidzakhala wodalira.

Chimodzi chimene ndimapempha kwa Yehova, chimodzi chimene ndimafunafuna: kuti ndizikhala mu nyumba ya Yehova masiku onse a moyo wanga, ndi kukondwerera kukongola kwa Yehova ndi kulingalira mu kachisi wake.
Pakuti adzandibisa pa tsiku la masautso. Adzanditeteza mu kachisi wake; adzandiika pamwamba pa thanthwe la chitetezo.
Tsopano mutu wanga udzakwezedwa pamwamba pa adani anga ondizinga. Pa kachisi wake ndidzapereka nsembe ndi kufuula ndi chimwemwe, ndi kuyimba zatamando za Yehova.
Mverani mawu anga, Yehova, ndikamafuula; ndichitireni chifundo ndi kundiyankha.
Mtima wanga ukunena za inu kuti, "Bwerani ndi kulankhula nane." Mtima wanga ukunena, "Yehova, ine ndikubwera."
Musabise nkhope yanu kwa ine. Musakwiye ndi kandibwezera, inu amene mwakhala thandizo langa. Musandisiye, musandiyiwale, Mulungu wopulumutsa wanga.
Ngakhale bambo ndi mayi anga andisiya, Yehova adzandilandira.
Ndiphunzitseni njira yanu, Yehova; nditsogolereni m'njira yowongoka chifukwa cha adani anga.
Musandipereke kwa adani anga, pakuti mboni zabodza zauka kuukira ine, zikundiopseza ndi chiwawa.
Komabe ndimakhulupirira ichi: Ndidzaona ubwino wa Yehova mu dziko la amoyo.
Yembekezerani Yehova; khalani olimba mtima ndi olimbika; inde, dikirani Yehova.
Ndimakuyitanani, Yehova, thanthwe langa. Musandilankhulire chete, pakuti ngati simuyankha, ndidzakhala ngati amene apita ku manda.
Mverani pemphero langa la chifundo pamene ndimakuyitanani thandizo, pamene ndimakweza manja anga kupempha ku malo anu oyera.
Musandichotsere pamodzi ndi anthu oyipa—amene amalankhula mwabwino kwa anzawo, koma m'mitima yawo muli zoyipa.
Awalipire chifukwa cha zochita zawo, mogwirizana ndi zoyipa zawo. Awalipire chifukwa cha ntchito za manja awo; abwezere zomwe akuyenera.
Iwo sanyalanyaze ntchito za Yehova kapena zomwe analenga ndi manja ake, choncho adzawagwetsa pansi ndipo sadzawakweza.
Atamandidwe Yehova! Pakuti wamva pemphero langa la chifundo.
Yehova ndi mphamvu yanga ndi chishango changa. Mtima wanga umadalira iye, ndipo amandithandiza. Mtima wanga ukukondwera ndi kudumphadumpha ndi chimwemwe; ndimayimba zatamando ndi nyimbo.
Yehova ndi mphamvu ya anthu ake, linga la chitetezo cha wodzozedwa wake.
Pulumutsani anthu anu! Dalitsani cholowa chanu! Khalani m'busa wawo ndi kuwasamalira kosatha.
Pereka kwa Yehova, inu angelo, perekani kwa Yehova ulemerero ndi mphamvu.
Perekani kwa Yehova ulemerero womwe dzina lake liyenera. Lambirani Yehova mu ulemerero wa chiyero chake.
Mawu a Yehova ali pamwamba pa madzi; Mulungu wa ulemerero amabangula. Yehova akubangula pamwamba pa madzi a nyanja.
Mawu a Yehova ndi amphamvu; mawu a Yehova ndi olemekezeka.
Mawu a Yehova amaswa mikungudza; Yehova amaswa mikungudza ya Lebanoni.
Amapanga Lebanoni kuti aluke ngati mwana wa ng'ombe, ndi Sirioni ngati mwana wa njati.
Mawu a Yehova akuluma malasha oyaka.
Mawu a Yehova akugwedeza chipululu; Yehova akugwedeza chipululu cha Kadesi.
Mawu a Yehova akuminya mitengo yathambo, ndi kuwononga nkhalango. Koma mu kachisi wake aliyense akuti, "Ulemerero!"
Yehova analamulira pa madzi a chigumula; Yehova adzalamulira ngati mfumu kosatha.
Yehova amapatsa anthu ake mphamvu; Yehova amadalitsa anthu ake ndi mtendere.
Ndidzakukwezani, Yehova, pakuti mwandikoka kuchokera m'kuya; simunalole adani anga andinyoze.
Yehova Mulungu wanga, ndinakuyitanani thandizo, ndipo munandichiritsa.
Mwandikoka, Yehova, kuchokera ku manda. Mwandipulumutsa kuti ndisapite ku dzenje la imfa.
Imbirani Yehova, inu okhulupirika ake. Yamikani dzina lake loyera.
Pakuti mkwiyo wake umakhala kwakanthawi, koma kukoma mtima kwake kumakhalitsa moyo wonse. Kulira kungafike usiku, koma chimwemwe chimabwera m'mawa.
Pamene ndinali ndi mphamvu, ndinkati, "Sindidzagwedezeka!"
Chifukwa cha kondwerero lanu, Yehova, mwandichititsa kukhala wolimba ngati phiri. Kenako munabisa nkhope yanu, ndipo ndinasokonezeka.
Ndinakuyitanani, Yehova; ndi kupempha chifundo kwa Yehova:
"Pali phindu lanji m'kufa kwanga, m'kuponyedwa kwanga ku manda? Kodi fumbi lingakutamandeni? Lingalengeze za kukhulupirika kwanu?
Mverani, Yehova, ndi kundichitira chifundo. Khalani thandizo langa."
Mwasandutsa kulira kwanga kukhala kuvina kwa chimwemwe; mwavula chovala changa cha chisoni ndi kundiveka chimwemwe,
kuti ndikuyimbireni nyimbo zatamando ndi kusakhala chete. Yehova Mulungu wanga, ndidzakuyamikani kosatha!
Yehova, ndimathawira mwa inu; musalole kuti ndichite manyazi. Pulumutseni, pakuti ndinu wolungama.
Tcherani khutu lanu kuti mundimve; bwerani msanga kudzandipulumutsa. Khalani thanthwe langa, malo anga otetezeka, linga lolimba kuti mundipulumutse.
Inu ndinu thanthwe langa ndi linga langa. Chifukwa cha ulemerero wa dzina lanu, nditsogolereni ndi kunditsogoza.
Ndichotseni mu msampha umene andiyikira, pakuti inu ndinu chitetezo changa.
Ndikupereka mzimu wanga m'manja mwanu. Ndilanditseni, Yehova, Mulungu wachoonadi.
Ndimadana ndi anthu opembedza mafano achabe; ndimakhulupirira Yehova.
Ndidzakondwera ndi kusangalala mu chikondi chanu chosasinthika, pakuti mwawona kuvutika kwanga; mukudziwa zovuta za moyo wanga.
Simunandipereke kwa adani anga, koma mwaika mapazi anga m'malo otakasuka.
Chitireni chifundo, Yehova, pakuti ndili pa mavuto. Maso anga abundirira ndi misozi. Thupi ndi moyo wanga zikufooketsedwa ndi chisoni.
Ndafa ndi chisoni; zaka zanga zikuchepetsedwa ndi kubuula. Mphamvu yanga yatha chifukwa cha kulakwa kwanga, ndipo mafupa anga akufooka.
Ndakhala chinthu chonyozeka kwa adani anga. Anansi anga ankandinyoza, ndipo abwenzi anga ali ndi mantha kundiyang'ana. Amene amandiwona m'misewu amandithawa.
Ndayiwalika ngati munthu wakufa; ndili ngati mphika wothyoka.
Ndimva mawu obisika a anthu ambiri; mantha amandizinga mbali zonse. Adani anga akukonzekera limodzi kuti andiphe.
Koma ndimakhulupirira inu, Yehova; ndinena kuti, "Inu ndinu Mulungu wanga!"
Tsogolo langa lili m'manja mwanu. Pulumutseni kwa adani anga ndi anthu amene amandithamangitsa.
Onani kapolo wanu ndi kukoma mtima kwanu; pulumutseni chifukwa cha chikondi chanu chosasinthika.
Yehova, musalole kuti ndichite manyazi, pakuti ndayitana inu kuti mundithandize. Lekani anthu oyipa achite manyazi; akhale chete m'manda awo.
Lekani milomo ya bodza ikhale chete—milomo yodzitamandira, yonyozeka, yotuka olungama.
Ndi yaikulu chotani kukoma mtima kwanu komwe mwasunga kwa amene amakuopani! Mumadalitsa amene amathawira mwa inu pamaso pa anthu onse.
Mumawabisa mu chitetezo cha pamaso panu kutali ndi anzeru za anthu oyipa; mumawateteza mu kachisi wanu kutali ndi malilime onyoza.
Atamandike Yehova, pakuti waonetsa chikondi chake chosasinthika kwa ine pamene ndinali mu mzinda wozingidwa.
Mu mantha anga ndinati, "Ndachotsedwa pamaso panu!" Koma munamva pemphero langa pamene ndinkalirira inu kuti mundithandize.
Kondani Yehova, inu nonse okhulupirika ake! Yehova amateteza amene amukhulupirira, koma amalanga kwambiri amene amadzitamandira.
Khalani olimba ndi olimba mtima, inu nonse amene mumayembekezera Yehova!
Wodala ndi munthu amene kupanduka kwake kwakhululukidwa, amene tchimo lake laphimbidwa.
Wodala ndi munthu amene Yehova samuwerengera mphulupulu, ndipo m'mtima mwake mulibe chinyengo.
Pamene ndinakana kuvomereza tchimo langa, thupi langa linatopa ndi kubuula kwanga tsiku lonse.
Usana ndi usiku dzanja lanu linkandiponderera; mphamvu yanga inatha ngati pa nyengo yotentha. Sela.
Pomalizira ndinavomereza machimo anga kwa inu; sindinabise mphulupulu zanga. Ndinati, "Ndidzavomereza kupanduka kwanga kwa Yehova," ndipo munandikhululukira machimo anga onse. Sela.
Choncho ali yense wokhulupirika apemphere kwa inu pamene anaona mavuto, kuti madzi a mavuto akafika asadzawafikire.
Pakuti inu ndinu malo anga obisalamo; mumanditeteza ku mavuto. Mumandizungulira ndi nyimbo za chipulumutso. Sela.
Yehova akuti, "Ndidzakulangiza ndi kukutsogolera mu njira yokwanira yopita; ndidzakulangiza ndi kukuyang'anira.
Musakhale opanda nzeru ngati kavalo kapena bulu amene amafunika tsabwa ndi mkanjo kuti uwatsogolere."
Anthu oyipa ali ndi mavuto ambiri, koma chikondi chosasinthika cha Yehova chimazinga amene amamukhulupirira.
Sangalalani mwa Yehova ndi kukondwera, inu olungama! Imbani inu nonse amene mtima wanu uli wolungama!
Imbirani Yehova mokondwera, inu olungama; ndi kotheka kuti olungama amutamande.
Tamandani Yehova ndi pangwe; imbirani nyimbo zatamando ndi zeze wa zingwe khumi.
Imbirani nyimbo yatsopano kwa Yehova; imbani mwaluso ndi kufuula mokondwera.
Pakuti mawu a Yehova ndi olungama, ndipo amachita zonse mokhulupirika.
Iye amakonda chilungamo ndi chiweruzo; chikondi chosasinthika cha Yehova chadzaza dziko lapansi.
Ndi mawu a Yehova kumwamba kunalengedwa, ndi nyenyezi zonse zinapangidwa ndi mpweya wa pakamwa pake.
Anatuluka madzi a m'nyanja ngati mu mpamba; anaika nyanja yakuya mu mosungiramo.
Lekani dziko lonse lapansi liope Yehova; lekani anthu onse a dziko lapansi amuope.
Pakuti analankhula, ndipo zinachitika; analamula, ndipo zinakhala zolimba.
Yehova amasokoneza maganizo a mitundu ya anthu; amalepheretsa zolinga zawo.
Koma maganizo a Yehova amakhalitsa kwamuyaya; zolinga za mtima wake ndi za mibadwo yonse.
Wodala ndi mtundu umene Mulungu wake ndi Yehova, anthu amene anawasankha kuti akhale ake.
Yehova amayang'ana kuchokera kumwamba; amaona anthu onse.
Kuchokera pa mpando wake wachifumu amayang'ana onse okhala m'dziko lapansi.
Iye anapanga mitima yawo, ndipo amazindikira chilichonse chimene amachita.
Mfumu siyipulumutsidwa ndi gulu lake la asilikali; nkhondo siyitetezedwa ndi mphamvu yake.
Kavalo wankhondo ndi chiyembekezo chabodza chopulumutsa; ngakhale ali ndi mphamvu zambiri sangapulumutse.
Koma Yehova amayang'ana amene amamuopa, amene amayembekezera chikondi chake chosasinthika.
Amawapulumutsa ku imfa, ndi kuwasamalira pa nthawi ya njala.
Tikuyembekezera Yehova kuti atithandize; iye ndi thandizo lathu ndi chishango chathu.
Mwa iye mitima yathu imakondwera, pakuti tikukhulupirira dzina lake loyera.
Yehova, chikondi chanu chosasinthika chikhale pa ife, ngati momwe tikuyembekezera mwa inu.
Ndidzayamika Yehova nthawi zonse; matamando ake adzakhala m'kamwa mwanga nthawi zonse.
Ndidzanyadira mwa Yehova; lekani odzichepetsa amve ndi kukondwera.
Bwerani, tikuze Yehova pamodzi; tonse pamodzi tikweze dzina lake.
Ndinapempha Yehova kuti andithandize, ndipo anandiyankha. Anandipulumutsa ku mantha anga onse.
Amene amamuyang'ana iye amawala ndi chimwemwe; nkhope zawo sizidzachita manyazi.
Mu mavuto anga ndinapemphera kwa Yehova, ndipo anamva ine; anandipulumutsa ku mavuto anga onse.
Mngelo wa Yehova amazinga amene amamuopa, ndipo amawapulumutsa.
Lawani ndi kuona kuti Yehova ndi wabwino; wodala ndi munthu amene amathawira mwa iye.
Opani Yehova, inu okhulupirika ake; amene amamuopa amapeza zonse zofunika.
Mikango ya msinkhu wabwino imafooka ndi njala, koma amene amayembekezera Yehova sadzasowa chinthu chabwino.
Bwerani, ana anga, ndipo mvetserani; ndidzakuphunzitsani kuopa Yehova.
Kodi mukufuna kukhala ndi moyo? Kodi mukufuna zaka zambiri zodzaza ndi zabwino?
Ndiye letsani lilime lanu kuti lisanene zoyipa, ndi milomo yanu kuti isanene mabodza!
Patukani ku zoyipa ndi kuchita zabwino. Funafuna mtendere ndi kuutsatira.
Maso a Yehova ali pa olungama, ndipo makutu ake amva kufuula kwawo kothandizidwa.
Koma Yehova amatsutsa anthu ochita zoyipa; adzachotsa kukumbukira kwawo m'dziko lapansi.
Olungama akafuula, Yehova amamva; amawapulumutsa ku mavuto awo onse.
Yehova ali pafupi ndi amene mtima wawo wasweka; amapulumutsa amene mzimu wawo wagonjetsedwa.
Olungama akhoza kukumana ndi mavuto ambiri, koma Yehova amawapulumutsa mu zonsezo.
Pakuti Yehova amasunga mafupa ake onse; palibe ngakhale limodzi lidzathyoke!
Choipa chidzapha anthu oyipa; amene amadana ndi olungama adzaweruzidwa.
Koma Yehova adzapulumutsa amene amamutumikira; palibe amene amathawira mwa iye adzaweruzidwe.
Yehova, tsutsani amene akunditsutsa ine. Menyani nawo amene akumenyana nane.
Tengani chishango chanu chachikulu ndi chaching'ono; konzekani kudzandithandiza.
Kwezani mkondo wanu ndi nkhwangwa motsutsana ndi amene akundithamangitsa. Ndiuzeni kuti, "Ine ndine chipulumutso chako!"
Achite manyazi ndi kunyozeka amene akufuna kundipha. Abwerere ndi kupita pa manyazi amene akukonzekera kuwononga ine.
Akhale ngati mungu utawululidwa ndi mphepo, mngelo wa Yehova akuwathamangitsa.
Njira yawo ikhale yamdima ndi yaterereka, mngelo wa Yehova akuwathamangitsa.
Anandiyikira ukonde popanda chifukwa; popanda chifukwa anakumba dzenje kuti ndigweremo.
Mwadzidzidzi chiwonongeko chiwagwere! Akodwe mu ukonde umene anaika; agwere mu dzenje liwawononge.
Pamenepo moyo wanga udzakondwera mwa Yehova, ndi kusangalala mu chipulumutso chake.
Mafupa anga onse adzanena kuti, "Yehova, ndani angafanizidwe ndi inu? Ndinu mtetezi wa anthu opanda mphamvu kwa amphamvu, otsitsimutsa anthu osowa kwa amene amawalanda."
Mboni zachinyengo zikundinena ine; akundifunsa za zinthu zomwe sindikuzidziwa.
Akundilipira choipa kwa ine pa zabwino, ndipo ndatengeka mosafuna.
Komatu pamene iwo anali odwala, ndinavala chovala chamasautso ndi kudzimana ndi kusala kudya. Ndinapemphera ndi mtima wonse,
ngati anali abwenzi anga kapena abale anga. Ndinawerera ndi chisoni ngati munthu wolira amayi ake.
Koma pamene ndinapunthwa, anasonkhana mokondwera; oneneza ankasonkhana motsutsana nane popanda chifukwa. Ankandinena popanda kusiya.
Amandinyoza ndi kundinena monyodola; amasenya mano awo motsutsana nane.
Ambuye, mpaka liti mudzangoyang'ana? Pulumutsani moyo wanga ku zinthu zoopsa zawo, moyo wanga wokongola ku mikango iyi.
Pamenepo ndidzakuyamikani pamaso pa msonkhano waukulu; ndidzakutamandani pakati pa anthu ambiri.
Musalole adani anga obwera popanda chifukwa akondwere. Musalole amene amadana nane popanda chifukwa azitseka diso modzudzula.
Sayankhula mawu a mtendere; amapanga zabodza zotsutsana ndi anthu opezeka mtendere m'dziko.
Amatsegula pakamwa pawo motsutsana nane, akuti, "Aha! Aha! Ndi maso athu tawona!"
Yehova, mwawona zimenezi! Musakhale chete. Musachoke kwa ine, Ambuye.
Dzukani! Imani kundilanditsa! Mulungu wanga ndi Ambuye wanga, ndilanditseni!
Ndiweruzeni mu chilungamo chanu, Yehova Mulungu wanga. Musawalole akondwere chifukwa cha mavuto anga.
Musawalole anene m'mitima yawo kuti, "Aha! Tikukondwera!" Musawalole anene kuti, "Tamumeza ndithu!"
Achite manyazi ndi kuchita manyazi onse amene amakondwera ndi mavuto anga. Avekedwe manyazi ndi kunyozeka onse amene amadzitamandira motsutsana nane.
Koma akondwere ndi kusangalala onse amene afuna kuti ndiwoneke wolungama; aziyimba kuti, "Yehova ndi waukulu! Amasangalala ndi kupambana kwa antchito ake!"
Ndidzanena za chilungamo chanu, ndi kukutamandani tsiku lonse.
Tchimo limalalikira mu mtima wa anthu oyipa. Kuopa Mulungu kulibe m'maso mwawo.
Mu kudzitamandira kwawo, sangaone tchimo lawo ndi kulidana nalo.
Zimene amayankhula ndi zoyipa ndi zabodza; analeka kuchita zanzeru ndi zabwino.
Ali pa kama lawo amakonzekera njira zoyipa; amadziyika pa njira yoyipa, sakana zoyipa.
Yehova, chikondi chanu chosasinthika chimafika kumwamba; kukhulupirika kwanu kumafika ku mitambo.
Chilungamo chanu chili ngati mapiri akuluakulu, chiweruzo chanu chili ngati nyanja yakuya. Yehova, mumasamalira anthu ndi nyama zonse.
Chikondi chanu chosasinthika ndi chamtengo wapatali, Mulungu wanga! Anthu onse amathawira mu mthunzi wa mapiko anu.
Akudya ku phwando lochuluka la nyumba yanu; mumawapatsa kumwa ku mtsinje wanu wa zochititsa chimwemwe.
Pakuti inu ndinu kasupe wa moyo, kuwala kwanu kumathandiza kuti tione kuwala.
Pitirizani kuonetsa chikondi chanu chosasinthika kwa amene amakudziwani; pitirizani kupereka chilungamo kwa amene mtima wawo uli woyera.
Musalole phazi la onyada lindiponderere kapena dzanja la oyipa kundithamangitsa.
Onani! Anthu ochita zoyipa agwa! Aponyedwa pansi, sadzauka.
Musavutike chifukwa cha anthu oyipa kapena kuchita nsanje ndi anthu ochita zoipa.
Pakuti posachedwa adzauma ngati udzu; adzafota mofulumira ngati maluwa a m'munda.
Khulupirirani Yehova ndi kuchita zabwino. Kenako mudzakhala mwa mtendere m'dziko ndi kupeza chakudya chodyetsa bwino.
Kondwerani ndi Yehova, ndipo iye adzakupatsani zofuna za mtima wanu.
Perekani zonse zimene mukuchita kwa Yehova; khulupirirani iye, ndipo iye adzakuthandizani.
Adzaonetsa kulungama kwa zochita zanu ngati kucha kwa kuwala, ndi chilungamo cha mlandu wanu ngati dzuwa la masana.
Khalani chete pamaso pa Yehova, ndi kumudikira mwaleza mtima. Musavutike chifukwa cha anthu opambana kapena chifukwa cha anthu ochita zoyipa.
Letsani kukwiya kwanu! Lekani mkwiyo! Musavutike—zimenezi zimangopangitsa zoyipa.
Pakuti ochita zoyipa adzachotsedwa, koma amene amayembekezera Yehova adzalandira dziko.
Pakanthawi pang'ono anthu oyipa adzapita; ngakhale muyang'ane kumene ankakhala, sapezekanso.
Koma anthu odzichepetsa adzalandira dziko; adzakhala ndi mtendere wochuluka.
Anthu oyipa amakonzekera zoyipa motsutsana ndi olungama; akusenya mano awo motsutsana nawo.
Koma Ambuye amaseka anthu oyipa, pakuti akudziwa kuti tsiku lawo lakuweruzidwa likubwera.
Anthu oyipa atulutsa malupanga awo ndi kukoka uta wawo, kuti aphe anthu osauka ndi osowa, kuti aphe amene njira zawo zili zolungama.
Koma malupanga awo adzapita m'mitima yawo, ndi mauta awo adzathyoka.
Zochepa za anthu olungama ziposa zambiri za anthu oyipa.
Pakuti mphamvu za anthu oyipa zidzasweka, koma Yehova amasamalira anthu olungama.
Yehova amayang'anira moyo wa anthu opanda chinthu, ndipo cholowa chawo chidzakhala muyaya.
Sadzachita manyazi pa nyengo zovuta; pa nthawi ya njala adzakhala ndi zambiri.
Koma anthu oyipa adzafa. Adani a Yehova adzakhala ngati maluwa a m'minda—adzasowa, adzakhala ngati utsi.
Anthu oyipa amakongola koma sabwezera; olungama amapereka mowolowamanja.
Amene Yehova amawadalitsa adzalandira dziko, koma amene amatemberera adzachotsedwa.
Yehova amalimbitsa mapazi a olungama; amakondwera ndi miyala iliyonse ya moyo wawo.
Ngakhale akapunthwa, sangagwe, pakuti Yehova amawagwira ndi dzanja lake.
Ndinali wamng'ono, tsopano ndakalamba, koma sindinawone wolungama wakusiyidwa kapena ana ake akupempha chakudya.
Anthu olungama nthawi zonse amapereka ndi kupatsa, ndipo ana awo amakhala madalitso.
Patukani ku zoyipa ndi kuchita zabwino, ndipo mudzakhalitsa kwa nthawi yayitali m'dziko.
Pakuti Yehova amakonda chilungamo, ndipo sadzasiya okhulupirika ake. Iye adzawateteza kwamuyaya, koma ana a anthu oyipa adzachotsedwa.
Olungama adzalandira dziko ndi kukhalamo muyaya.
Pakamwa pa olungama palankhula nzeru, ndipo lilime lawo limalankhula chilungamo.
Lamulo la Mulungu wawo lili m'mitima yawo; sadzapunthwa pa mapazi awo.
Anthu oyipa amayang'anira olungama, akufuna mwayi woti awaphe.
Koma Yehova sadzawasiya m'manja mwawo, kapena kuwalola kuti aweruzidwe akaimbidwa mlandu.
Yembekezerani Yehova ndi kusunga njira yake, ndipo iye adzakukweza kuti mulandire dziko. Pamene anthu oyipa achotsedwa, mudzaona.
Ndinawona munthu woyipa wamphamvu, ali ngati mtengo wokhwima womera m'dothi labwino.
Koma pamene ndinadutsanso, sanapezeke. Ndinamufunafuna, koma sanapezekenso.
Yang'anani anthu olungama; onani anthu olungama: Ali ndi tsogolo labwino, anthu a mtendere.
Koma opanduka adzawonongedwa onse pamodzi; tsogolo la anthu oyipa lidzachotsedwa.
Yehova amapulumutsa anthu olungama; iye ndi malo awo otetezeka pa nthawi ya mavuto.
Yehova amawathandiza ndi kuwapulumutsa; amawapulumutsa kwa anthu oyipa ndi kuwasunga, pakuti amathawira mwa iye.
Yehova, musandidzudzule mukukwiya, kapena kundilanga mu mkwiyo wanu!
Mivi yanu yandilasa, ndipo dzanja lanu landiponderera.
Chifukwa cha mkwiyo wanu, thupi langa lili lodwala; chifukwa cha tchimo langa, mafupa anga akupweteka.
Tchimo langa landizinga; lili ngati katundu wolemera kwambiri kuti ndingathe kunyamula.
Mabala anga ali ndi mafinya ndipo akununkha, chifukwa cha kupusa kwanga.
Ndapindika ndi kugwedezeka; ndayenda mowawidwa tsiku lonse.
Mphafa zanga zatentha kwambiri; thupi langa lonse lili lodwala.
Ndafooketsedwa ndi kugwedezedwa kotheratu. Ndimabuula chifukwa cha chisoni cha mtima wanga.
Ambuye, mukudziwa zofuna zanga zonse; kufuula kwanga sikukubisika kwa inu.
Mtima wanga ukugunda mwamphamvu, ndayiwala mphamvu zanga, ngakhale kuwala kwa maso anga kwapita.
Abwenzi anga ndi achikondi anga akundipewa chifukwa cha matenda anga; ngakhale a m'banja mwanga akhala kutali.
Amene amafuna kupha ine akundiyikira misampha; amene amafuna kundivulaza akukambirana zachiwawa, akukonza zachinyengo tsiku lonse.
Koma ine sindimva, ngati wogontha; ndili chete ngati wosalankhula.
Ndili ngati munthu amene samva, amene mu kamwa mwake mulibe yankho.
Pakuti ine ndimadikira inu, Yehova. Inu mudzandiyankha, Ambuye Mulungu wanga.
Ndinanena kuti, "Musawalole akondwere chifukwa cha mavuto anga, kapena kudzitamandira pakanditerera phazi langa."
Ndili pafupi kugwa, ndipo chisoni changa sichimasiya.
Ndimavomereza machimo anga; mavuto anga andidetsa nkhawa.
Ndili ndi adani ambiri amphamvu; ambiri amene amandida popanda chifukwa.
Akundilipira choipa kwa zabwino zomwe ndawachitira, akundinena chifukwa ndimatsata zabwino.
Musandisiye, Yehova! Musakhale kutali nane, Mulungu wanga!
Bwerani msanga kudzandithandiza, Ambuye, Mpulumutsi wanga.
Ndinanena kuti, "Ndidzasamala m'zochita zanga ndi kupewa kuchimwa ndi lilime langa. Ndidzasunga pakamwa panga pamene anthu oyipa ali pafupi nane."
Koma pamene ndinakhala chete ndi osanena ngakhale chinthu chimodzi chabwino, mavuto anga anakulira.
Mtima wanga unatentha m'kati mwanga; pamene ndinkasinkhasinkha, moto unayaka. Pamapeto pake ndinayankhula:
"Yehova, ndionetseni mathero anga ndi nthawi imene moyo wanga uli nayo. Ndizindikiritseni kufupi kwa moyo wanga.
Mwapatsa moyo wanga zaka zingapo; pamaso panu zaka zanga ndi monga si chinthu. Anthu onse, ngakhale ali ndi mphamvu kwambiri, ali monga mpweya wopepuka. Sela.
Munthu amayendayenda ngati mthunzi; amavutika kwambiri popanda phindu. Amaunjikira chuma osadziwa amene adzachilandira.
Koma tsopano, Ambuye, kodi ndiyembekezera chiyani? Chiyembekezo changa chili mwa inu.
Ndilanditseni ku machimo anga onse. Musandichititse manyazi ndi opusa.
Ndili chete; sindidzayankhulanso, pakuti chilango ichi chichokera kwa inu.
Chotsani chilango chanu pa ine; ndafa ndi mkwiyo wa dzanja lanu.
Mukamadzudzula ndi kulanga munthu chifukwa cha tchimo, mumawononga zonse zomwe amakonda ngati za njere; munthu mosakayikira ndi mpweya. Sela.
Mverani pemphero langa, Yehova! Mverani kufuula kwanga kothandizidwa! Musakhale chete pamene ndikulira. Pakuti ine ndili mlendo pamaso panu, wopita kwa kanthawi monga makolo anga onse.
Ndilekereni kuti ndikondwerenso ndisanafe.
Ndinadikira mwaleza mtima Yehova kuti andithandize, ndipo anatembenukira kwa ine ndi kumva kufuula kwanga.
Anandikoka m'dzenje la chiwonongeko, mu matope owopsa. Anandiika pa thanthwe lolimba, ndi kupanga kuti mapazi anga akhale olimba pamene ndikuyenda.
Anandipatsa nyimbo yatsopano kuti ndiimbe, nyimbo yotamanda Mulungu wathu. Ambiri adzaona zomwe wachita ndi kuopa. Adzakhulupirira Yehova.
Wodala ndi munthu amene amakhulupirira Yehova, amene satembenukira kwa onyada kapena kwa amene amapembedza mafano achabe.
Yehova Mulungu wanga, mwachita zambiri zodabwitsa! Ndi maganizo anu okhudza ife, palibe wina yemwe angafanizidwe ndi inu! Ngati ndikadayesa kunena za zonsezo, sindingathe—zambiri kuti ziwerengeke.
Simunafune nsembe za nyama kapena zopereka. Munandipatsa makutu kuti ndimve. Simunafune zopereka zopsereza kapena zopereka za tchimo.
Ndiye ndinati, "Onani, ndabwera. Monga zinalembedwa za ine m'mabuku achipangano:
Ndimakondwera kuchita chifuniro chanu, Mulungu wanga, pakuti malamulo anu ali mu mtima wanga."
Ndalengeza nkhani yabwino ya chilungamo chanu kwa msonkhano waukulu. Sindinasiye kunena za chilungamo chanu, monga inu mukudziwira, Yehova.

Sindinabise nkhani yabwino ya chilungamo chanu mu mtima wanga; ndinalankhula za kukhulupirika kwanu ndi mphamvu zanu zopulumutsa. Sindinabise chikondi chanu chosasinthika ndi kukhulupirika kwanu kwa msonkhano waukulu.
Yehova, musandichotsere chifundo chanu. Chikondi chanu chosasinthika ndi kukhulupirika kwanu zindiyang'anire nthawi zonse.
Pakuti mavuto opanda chiyerekezo andizinga; machimo anga andigwira mpaka sindikuthanso kuona. Achuluka kuposa tsitsi la mu mutu wanga. Ndataya mtima.
Chondelezeni, Yehova, kundipulumutsa! Bwerani msanga, Yehova, kudzandithandiza.
Achite manyazi ndi kunyozeka onse amene akufuna kupha ine; abwerere ndi kuchita manyazi onse amene akukondwera ndi mavuto anga.
Achite mantha chifukwa cha manyazi awo, onse amene amati kwa ine, "Aha! Aha!"
Koma akhale akudzazidwa ndi chimwemwe ndi kukondwa onse amene amakufunafunani. Amene amakonda chipulumutso chanu nthawi zonse anene kuti, "Yehova ndi waukulu!"
Pakuti ine ndili wosauka ndi wosowa, koma Ambuye amandiyang'anira. Ndinu thandizo langa ndi mpulumutsi wanga. Mulungu wanga, musachedwe.
Wodala ndi amene amaganizira anthu osauka. Yehova adzawapulumutsa pa nthawi yawo ya mavuto.
Yehova adzawateteza ndi kuwasunga ndi moyo. Adzawadalitsa pamaso pa adani awo, ndipo sadzawapereka kwa adani awo kuti achite zofuna zawo.
Yehova amawapatsa mphamvu pa mphasa yawo ya matenda; amawasamalira pamene akudwala.
"Yehova," ndinati, "Chitireni chifundo. Chiritseni, pakuti ndakuchimwirani."
Adani anga akundinena monyodola, akuti, "Adzafa liti ndi kuyiwalika dzina lake?"
Akabwera kudzandiona, akhala akunena mawu opanda pake; mtima wawo umaunjikira nkhani zoyipa, kenako amapita kunja kuti akawafalitse.
Adani anga onse amasonkhana ndi kunong'ona za ine, akukonzekera zoyipa kwa ine.
Akuti, "Wagwidwa ndi chinthu choipa. Sadzaukanso pa mphasa imene wagonayo."
Ngakhale bwenzi langa lapamtima, amene ndinkamukhulupirira, amene anadya chakudya changa, watembenukira kwa ine.
Yehova, chitireni chifundo. Ndiukitseni kuti ndiwabwezere!
Ndikudziwa kuti mukukondwera nane, pakuti mwalola kuti adani anga asapambane.
Mwandichirikiza chifukwa cha kulungama kwanga; mwandiyimika pamaso panu kwamuyaya.
Atamandike Yehova, Mulungu wa Israeli, amene amakhalapo kuyambira muyaya mpaka muyaya. Ame ndi Ame!
Monga mbawala imafuula chifukwa cha madzi a mtsinje, momwemonso moyo wanga umafuula chifukwa cha inu, Mulungu.
Mtima wanga uli ndi ludzu la Mulungu, Mulungu wamoyo. Kodi ndingathe liti kupita ndi kuima pamaso pa Mulungu?
Misozi yanga yakhala chakudya changa usana ndi usiku, pamene adani anga akundifunsa nthawi zonse, "Mulungu wako ali kuti?"
Mtima wanga ukunjenjemera ndikakumbukira: ndinatsogolera khamu lalikulu la anthu kupita ku nyumba ya Mulungu, akuyimba ndi kufuula mokondwera ndi kuyamika—khamu lalikulu pa chikondwerero.
N'chifukwa chiyani uli wachisoni, moyo wanga? N'chifukwa chiyani uli wodandaula? Yembekezera Mulungu! Ndidzamuyamikanso—Mpulumutsi wanga ndi
Mulungu wanga! Tsopano moyo wanga uli wachisoni mkati mwanga, choncho ndikukukumbukirani—ngakhale kuchokera kutali ku Yorodano ndi kuphiri la Heremoni, kuchokera ku phiri la Mizara.
Madzi akuya akuyitana madzi akuya pakulira kwa mathithi anu. Mafunde anu onse ndi mphepo zamkuntho zandiponderera.
Koma usana uliwonse Yehova amaonetsa chikondi chake chosasinthika, ndipo usiku uliwonse ndimayimba nyimbo zake, ndi kupemphera kwa Mulungu amene amandipatsa moyo.
"Mulungu, thanthwe langa," ndimafuula, "N'chifukwa chiyani mwandiyiwala? N'chifukwa chiyani ndiyenera kuyenda mu chisoni, ndoponderedwa ndi adani anga?"
Mawu awo onyodola amaphwanya mafupa anga. Akundifunsa nthawi zonse, "Mulungu wako ali kuti?"
N'chifukwa chiyani uli wachisoni, moyo wanga? N'chifukwa chiyani uli wodandaula? Yembekezera Mulungu! Ndidzamuyamikanso—Mpulumutsi wanga ndi Mulungu wanga!
Ndilamulireni mlandu wanga, Mulungu! Ndilanditseni kwa anthu osakhulupirika; ndipulumutseni kwa anthu opanda chilungamo ndi achinyengo.
Pakuti inu ndinu Mulungu amene amanditeteza. N'chifukwa chiyani mwandikana? N'chifukwa chiyani ndizingoyenda mu chisoni, ndoponderedwa ndi adani anga?
Tumizani kuwala kwanu ndi choonadi chanu; lekani zinditsogolere. Lekani zindibweretse ku phiri lanu loyera, ku malo amene mumakhala.
Pamenepo ndidzapita ku guwa la Mulungu, kwa Mulungu—gwero la chimwemwe changa. Ndidzakuyamikani ndi pangwe, Mulungu, Mulungu wanga!
N'chifukwa chiyani uli wachisoni, moyo wanga? N'chifukwa chiyani uli wodandaula? Yembekezera Mulungu! Ndidzamuyamikanso—Mpulumutsi wanga ndi Mulungu wanga!
Mulungu, tinamva ndi makutu athu—makolo athu anatiuza zonse zomwe munachita mu masiku awo, kale lomwe lija.
Munathamangitsa mitundu yotsutsana ndi makolo athu, ndi kuwakhazikitsa m'malo. Munaphwanya adani awo ndi kuwalola kuti aphuke.
Sanalandire dziko ndi malupanga awo, kapena mphamvu zawo siziwapulumutsa. Koma anali dzanja lanu lamanja, mphamvu yanu, ndi kuwala kwa pamaso panu—pakuti munawakonda.
Inu ndinu Mfumu yanga ndi Mulungu wanga. Lamulani zopambana za Yakobo!
Mu mphamvu zanu, timakankhira adani athu pansi. Mu dzina lanu, timapondereza amene amatiukira.
Sindikukhulupirira uta wanga; sindiganiza kuti lupanga langa lingandipulumutse.
Inu ndinu amene mumatipambanitsa adani athu; mumatsitsa mu manyazi amene amatida.
Tsiku lonse timanyadira mu Mulungu wathu, ndipo tidzayamika dzina lanu kosatha. Sela.
Koma tsopano mwatikana ndi kutichotsa pamaso panu. Simunaperekenso asilikali athu kunkhondo.
Mwatipangitsa kuti tibwerere kuchokera kwa adani athu, ndipo amene amatida atilanda zinthu zathu.
Mwatipereka kuti tidyedwe ngati nkhosa, ndipo mwatibalalitsa pakati pa mitundu.
Munagulitsa anthu anu pa mtengo wotsika; sumunaipindule kanthu pa kugulitsidwa kwawo.
Mwatipanga kuti tikhale chinthu chonyozeka kwa anansi athu. Tikuseka ndi kunyodola anthu otizungulira.
Mwatichititsa kukhala chinthu chosekedwa pakati pa mitundu. Anthu akugwedeza mitu yawo motinyodola.
Manyazi anga ali pamaso panga tsiku lonse, ndipo nkhope yanga yakwiriridwa ndi kunyozeka,
chifukwa cha mawu a anthu otinyodola ndi otitukwana, chifukwa cha mdani amene akufuna kubwezera.
Zonsezi zatigwera, ngakhale sitinakuyiwaleni kapena kuphwanya pangano lanu.
Mitima yathu sinabwerere; mapazi athu sanachoke pa njira yanu.
Komatu mwatiphwanya ku malo a nkhandwe ndi kutiveka mthunzi wakuda ngati wa imfa.
Tikadayiwala dzina la Mulungu wathu, ndi kutambasula manja athu kuti tipembedze mulungu wachilendo,
kodi Mulungu sakanazindikira? Pakuti iye amadziwa zinsinsi za mtima wa munthu aliyense.
Koma chifukwa cha inu, timaphedwa tsiku lonse; timawerengedwa ngati nkhosa zopita kuwaphedwa.
Dzukani, Ambuye! N'chifukwa chiyani mukugona? Dzukani! Musatikane kosatha!
N'chifukwa chiyani mukutembenuza nkhope yanu kuchoka kwa ife? N'chifukwa chiyani mukunyalanyaza zovuta zathu ndi zilichila zathu?
Tatsitsidwa pansi mu fumbi; matupi athu agwetsedwa pansi.
Imani! Tithandizeni! Tilanditseni chifukwa cha chikondi chanu chosasinthika.
Mawu okongola akudzaza mtima wanga. Ndidzanena mawu okongola kwa mfumu, lilime langa lili ngati cholembera cha wolemba waluso.
Inu ndinu wokongola kwambiri pakati pa anthu. Mawu okoma mtima amatuluka m'kamwa mwanu. Mulungu wakudalitsani kwamuyaya.
Manga lupanga lanu pa chiuno chanu, mngwazi! Munakwere mu ulemerero ndi ulemu.
Mu ulemerero wanu, pitani patsogolo mwakupambana, kuteteza choonadi, kudzichepetsa, ndi chilungamo. Yendani patsogolo kuti muonetse zochita zoopsa!
Mivi yanu yakuthwa idzaba m'mitima ya adani anu, ndipo mitundu idzagwa pansi pa mapazi anu.
Mpando wanu wachifumu, Mulungu, ulipo kwamuyaya. Mumalamulira ndi ndodo yachilungamo.
Mumakonda chilungamo ndi kudana ndi zoyipa. Choncho Mulungu, Mulungu wanu, wakudozani ndi mafuta a chimwemwe, kuposa mafumu ena onse.
Zovala zanu zonse zimanunkhira ndi mure ndi aloe ndi kasiya. Mu nyumba zachifumu zomangidwa ndi minyanga ya njovu, nyimbo zopangidwa ndi zoimbira zazingwe zikondweretsa inu.
Ana a mfumu ali pakati pa atsikana okongola achikondi anu. Kudzanja lanu lamanja kuli mbeta yanu, mfumukazi, yatsekedwa ndi golide wabwino.
Mverani, mwana wamkazi! Onani ndi kutchera khutu. Iyiwaleni anthu anu ndi banja la abambo anu.
Pakuti mfumu yanu inakhumba kukongola kwanu; ipembedzeni, pakuti iye ndi mbuye wanu.
Mfumukazi ya Turo idzakubweretsereni mphatso. Anthu olemera adzapempha kondwerero kwa inu.
Mwana wamkazi wachifumu ali wokongola mu chipinda chake. Chovala chake chaukwati chalukidwa ndi golide.
Mu zovala zopangidwa mokongola, akuperekedwa kwa mfumu, pamodzi ndi anzake achikondi.
Akubwera mokondwa ndi mwa chimwemwe; akulowa mu nyumba ya mfumu.
Ana anu adzatenga malo a makolo anu; mudzawapanga kukhala ana a mfumu m'dziko lonse lapansi.
Ndidzakumbukira dzina lanu kwa mibadwomibadwo, ndipo mitundu idzakuyamikani kwamuyaya ndi kosatha.
Mulungu ndi pothawira pathu ndi mphamvu yathu, thandizo lokondzeka pa nthawi ya mavuto.
Choncho sitidzaopa, ngakhale dziko lapansi litagwedezeka ndi mapiri akagwa pakati pa nyanja;
ngakhale madzi ake awombe ndi kuyanga, ndipo mapiri agwedezeke ndi mafunde awo. Sela.
Pali mtsinje umene mitsinje yake imakondweretsa mzinda wa Mulungu, malo oyera amene Wamkuludzukulu amakhala.
Mulungu ali mu mzinda umenewo; sungasokonezeke. Pa kucha, Mulungu adzauthandiza.
Mitundu ikuwomba, maufumu agwedezeka. Mulungu walankhula, ndipo dziko lapansi likusungunuka.
Yehova wa Maulamuliro ali nafe; Mulungu wa Yakobo ndi malo athu otetezeka. Sela.
Bwerani, onani ntchito za Yehova; onani zinthu zozizwitsa zimene amachita pa dziko lapansi.
Amaletsa nkhondo padziko lonse lapansi. Amathyola uta ndi kuphwanya mkondo. Amatentha zishango ndi moto.
"Khalani chete, ndipo dziwani kuti ine ndine Mulungu! Ndidzakwezedwa pakati pa mitundu. Ndidzakwezedwa pa dziko lonse lapansi."
Yehova wa Maulamuliro ali nafe; Mulungu wa Yakobo ndi malo athu otetezeka. Sela.
Bwerani, inu nonse anthu, womberani m'manja! Fuulani kwa Mulungu ndi mawu okondwera!
Pakuti Yehova Wamkuludzukulu ndi woopsa! Iye ndi Mfumu yaikulu pa dziko lonse lapansi.
Anatigonjetsera mitundu, ndi kuyika anthu pansi pa mapazi athu.
Anatisankhira cholowa chathu, chinthu chodzitamandira cha Yakobo, amene amamukonda. Sela.
Mulungu wakwera ndi kufuula kwakukulu kwa chimwemwe; Yehova wakwera ndi kulira kwa lipenga.
Imbirani Mulungu nyimbo zatamando, imbirani! Imbirani Mfumu yathu nyimbo zatamando, imbirani!
Pakuti Mulungu ndi Mfumu pa dziko lonse lapansi. Imbirani nyimbo zatamando ndi nzeru.
Mulungu amalamulira pa mitundu, akukhala pa mpando wake wachifumu woyera.
Olamulira a mitundu asonkhana ngati anthu a Mulungu wa Abrahamu. Pakuti zishango zonse za dziko lapansi ndi za Mulungu. Iye akwezedwa kwambiri.
Yehova ndi waukulu! Ali woyenera kuyamikidwa kwambiri mu mzinda wa Mulungu wathu, womwe uli pa phiri lake loyera!
Phiri lake ndi lokongola kuti liwoneke; chimwemwe cha dziko lonse lapansi! Phiri la Ziyoni, mzinda wa Mfumu yaikulu, kumpoto.
Mulungu mwiniwake ali mu nyumba zachifumu za Ziyoni; akuonetsa kuti iye ndi mtetezi.
Mafumu a dziko lapansi anasonkhana; anaonana pamodzi.
Koma pamene anauwona, anadabwa; anachita mantha ndi kuthawa.
Mantha anawagwira; anavutika ngati mayi yemwe ali ndi mimba pofuna kubereka.
Munawononga sitima zazikulu za Tarisisi ndi mphepo yochokera kummawa.
Tinamva za ulemerero wa mzinda, koma tsopano taonadi—mu mzinda wa Yehova wa Maulamuliro, mu mzinda wa Mulungu wathu. Mulungu adzaupanga kukhala wokhazikika kwamuyaya. Sela.
Mulungu, tikulingalira chikondi chanu chosasinthika pamene tili mu kachisi wanu.
Monga dzina lanu, Mulungu, momwemonso matamando anu amafika ku malekezero a dziko lapansi. Dzanja lanu lamanja lili lodzazidwa ndi chipambano.
Lekani phiri la Ziyoni likondwere! Lekani atsikana a Yuda akondwere chifukwa cha chiweruzo chanu.
Yendani mozungulira Ziyoni ndi kuuwerengera; werengani nsanja zake.
Onani mu mtima mwanu mipanda yake; yang'anani malinga ake, kuti mukauze mibadwo yotsatira.
Pakuti uyu ndi Mulungu wathu kosatha ndi kosatha; iye adzakhala mtsogoleri wathu mpaka pa imfa.
Mverani izi, inu mitundu yonse! Tcherani makutu, inu nonse okhala m'dziko lapansi!
Aukulu ndi ang'ono, olemera ndi osauka—mverani!
Pakamwa panga padzanena nzeru, ndipo maganizo a mtima wanga adzapereka kuzindikira.
Ndidzatchera khutu langa kuti ndimve mwambi; ndidzayankha funso lovuta ndi pangwe.
Bwanji ndizachita mantha pa nthawi ya zovuta, pamene adani anga andizinga,
amene amakhulupirira chuma chawo ndi kudzitamandira ndi kuchuluka kwa katundu wawo?
Komatu palibe amene angagule moyo wa wina; palibe amene angapereke chiombolo kwa Mulungu kuti apulumutse moyo.
Mtengo wa moyo ndi waukulu kwambiri; siwungalipiridwe kwathunthu,
kuti munthu akhale ndi moyo kwamuyaya, ndi kupewa kupita ku manda.
Pakuti tikuona kuti anthu anzeru amafa, ngakhale opusa ndi opanda nzeru amafa, kusiya chuma chawo kwa ena.
Manda ndiwo nyumba yawo kosatha, malo awo a kukhala mu mibadwo yonse, ngakhale akadatcha dziko ndi mayina awo.
Koma munthu, ngakhale ali ndi ulemu, sangakhalitse; ali ngati nyama imene imafa.
Iyi ndi tsogolo la odzitamandira, ndi la otsatira awo, amene amayamikira mawu awo. Sela.
Ali ngati nkhosa zoperekedwa kuwadya ku manda; imfa idzakhala m'busa wawo. M'mawa, olungama adzawalamulira. Matupi awo adzawolala m'manda, kutali ndi nyumba zawo zachifumu.
Koma ine, Mulungu adzandipulumutsa moyo wanga; adzanditenga kuchokera mu mphamvu ya manda. Sela.
Choncho usavutike pamene anthu ena akulemera, pamene ulemerero wa nyumba zawo ukukula.
Pakuti akadzafa, sadzatenga chilichonse pamodzi nawo; ulemerero wawo sudzapita pansi nawo.
M'moyo wawo, anali oyenera kudzitamandira, ndipo anthu amawayamika chifukwa cha kupambana kwawo.
Komatu adzakhala pamodzi ndi makolo awo, amene sadzaonanso kuwala.
Anthu ali ndi ulemu, koma ngati alibe nzeru, ali ngati nyama, zomwe zimafa.
Yehova, Mulungu wamphamvu, Mulungu, walankhula. Wayitana anthu onse a dziko lapansi, kuchokera kotulukira dzuwa kufika kolowera.
Kuchokera mu Ziyoni, mzinda woyenera kukongola, Mulungu akuwala mu ulemerero.
Mulungu wathu akubwera, koma osati chete; moto ukuwononga patsogolo pake, ndipo namondwe ukuzungulira mwamphamvu.
Akuyitana kumwamba kumwambamwamba ndi dziko lapansi, kuti aweruze anthu ake.
"Bweretsani okhulupirika anga kwa ine—amene anachita pangano nane mwa kupereka nsembe."
Kenako lekani kumwamba kulengeze chilungamo chake, pakuti Mulungu mwiniwake ndi woweruza. Sela.
"Mverani, anthu anga, ndipo ndidzayankhula. Israeli, ndidzapereka umboni motsutsana ndi inu. Pakuti ine ndine Mulungu, Mulungu wanu.
Sindikukudzudzulani chifukwa cha nsembe zanu kapena nsembe zanu zopsereza, zomwe nthawi zonse muli kundipereka.
Koma sindifuna ng'ombe yamphongo kuchokera m'khola lanu kapena mbuzi za m'khola lanu.
Pakuti nyama zonse za m'nkhalango ndi zanga, ndi ng'ombe pa mapiri zikwizikwi.
Ndimadziwa mbalame iliyonse ya m'mapiri, ndipo nyama zakuthengo ndi zanga.
Ngati ndikanakhala ndi njala, sindikadakuuza, pakuti dziko lonse lapansi ndi zonse zomwe zili mwake ndi zanga.
Kodi ndimadya nyama ya ng'ombe yamphongo kapena kumwa magazi a mbuzi?
Perekani nsembe yoyamika kwa Mulungu, ndi kukwaniritsa malonjezo anu kwa Wamkuludzukulu.
Kenako mundiyitane pa nthawi ya mavuto, ndipo ndidzakupulumutsani, ndipo mudzandipatsa ulemu."
Koma kwa anthu oyipa Mulungu akuti, "N'chifukwa chiyani mukuyimba malamulo anga ndi kunena za pangano langa?
Pakuti mumadana ndi malangizo anga ndipo mumakana mawu anga.
Mukaona wakuba, mumakhala bwenzi naye; mumakhala pakati pa achigololo.
Pakamwa panu padzaza mawu oyipa, ndipo lilime lanu lili lodzazidwa ndi chinyengo.
Mumakhala ndi kuyankhula motsutsana ndi mbale wanu; mumayankhula zonyozeka za mwana wa amayi anu.
Pamene mumachita zinthu izi, ine ndinakhala chete, ndipo mumaganiza kuti ndili wofanana ndi inu. Koma tsopano ndikukudzudzulani; ndiyika nkhani yanu pamaso panu.
Lingalirani izi, inu amene mumayiwala Mulungu, kuti ndingakukhadzeni mu zidutswa popanda wina wokupulumutsani.
Koma kupereka thokozo nsembe ndiko kundipatsa ulemu. Ngati mukutsata njira yolungama, ndidzakuonetsani chipulumutso cha Mulungu."
Mulungu, chitireni chifundo chifukwa cha chikondi chanu chosasinthika; chifukwa cha chifundo chanu chachikulu, chotsani machimo anga.
Ndichapeni kuti ndikhale woyera ku machimo anga; ndiyeretseni ku tchimo langa.
Pakuti ndimadziwa kupanduka kwanga; tchimo langa lili pamaso panga nthawi zonse.
Ndakuchimwirani inu nokha; ndachita chimene chili choyipa pamaso panu. Mudzakhala olungama mukamandiweruza, ndipo chiweruzo chanu chidzakhala chosatsutsika.
Pakuti ndinabadwa wochimwa—inde, kuyambira pamene amayi anga anandiyimitsa.
Komatu mumafuna kukhulupirika m'kati mwanga, ndipo mumandiphunzitsa nzeru mu mtima mwanga.
Ndiyeretseni ndi hisope, ndipo ndidzakhala woyera; ndichapeni, ndipo ndidzakhala woyera kuposa chipale.
Mubwerenitseni chimwemwe ndi chisangalalo; mwathyola mafupa anga—lekani akondwere.
Bisani nkhope yanu pa machimo anga, ndipo chotsani mphulupulu zanga zonse.
Lengani mtima woyera mwa ine, Mulungu. Konzanitsanso mzimu wokhulupirika m'kati mwanga.
Musandichotse pamaso panu, ndipo musandichotsere mzimu wanu woyera.
Bwerenitseni chimwemwe cha chipulumutso chanu, ndipo ndichititseni kufuna kukumvera.
Kenako ndidzaphunzitsa anthu opanduka njira zanu, ndipo ochimwa adzabwerera kwa inu.
