Inu, Ambuye, ndinu wabwino ndi wokonzeka kukhululuka, wodzaza ndi chikondi chosasinthika kwa onse amene amakuyitanani.
Mverani mosamala pemphero langa, Yehova; mverani kupempha kwanga kothandizidwa.
Ndidzakuyitanani pa nthawi ya mavuto, pakuti mudzandiyankha.
Palibe mulungu wina ngati inu, Ambuye. Palibe ntchito ngati zanu!
Mitundu yonse imene munalenga idzabwera ndi kugwadira pamaso panu, Ambuye; idzapatsa ulemu dzina lanu.
Pakuti inu ndinu waukulu ndi mumachita zinthu zodabwitsa. Inu nokha ndinu Mulungu.
Ndiphunzitseni njira yanu, Yehova, kuti ndizitsata; lekani mtima wanga undiopeni.
Ndi mtima wanga wonse ndidzakuyamikani, Ambuye Mulungu wanga; ndidzapatsa ulemu dzina lanu kosatha.
Pakuti chikondi chanu chosasinthika kwa ine ndi chachikulu. Mwandipulumutsa ku malo akuya a manda.
Mulungu, anthu odzitamandira andiukira; gulu la ankhanza likufuna kupha ine. Sasamala kanthu za inu.
Koma inu, Ambuye, ndinu Mulungu wachifundo ndi wokoma mtima, wodikira mokwiya, wodzaza ndi chikondi chosasinthika ndi kukhulupirika.
Tembenukirani kwa ine ndi kundichitira chifundo. Patsani mphamvu yanu kapolo wanu; pulumutsani mwana wa kapolo wanu wamkazi.
Patseni chizindikiro cha kondwerero kwanu pa ine. Pamenepo amene amada ine adzaona ndi kuchita manyazi, pakuti inu, Yehova, mwandithandiza ndi kunditonthoza.
Pa phiri lake loyera akhazikitsa mzinda wake.
Yehova amakonda mzinda wa Yerusalemu kuposa mizinda yonse mu Israeli.
Zinthu zaulemerero zayankhulidwa za inu, mzinda wa Mulungu! Sela.
Ndidzaika Igupto ndi Babulo pakati pa amene amandidziwa—ngakhalenso Filisitia ndi Turo, ndi Etiopia. Adzati, "Ndinabadwira ku Ziyoni!"
Ndipo za Ziyoni adzati, "Aliyense ndi mwana wake; Wamkuludzukulu adzaikhazikitsa."
Pamene Yehova akulemba mu kaundula wa anthu, adzati, "Uyu anabadwira kumeneko." Sela.
Ndi anthu oimba ndi anthu ovina, akuyimba kuti, "Akasupe anga onse ali mwa inu."
Yehova, Mulungu wa chipulumutso changa, ndimafuula usana ndi usiku pamaso panu.
Tsopano mverani pemphero langa; tcherani khutu kufuula kwanga.
Pakuti moyo wanga wadzaza ndi mavuto, ndipo imfa ili pafupi.
Ndawerengeredwa pakati pa amene akupita ku dzenje. Ndili ngati munthu wopanda mphamvu.
Andipereka pakati pa akufa, akugona m'manda, amene simukukumbukirani, amene mwawasiya pa chitetezo chanu.
Mwandiponya mu dzenje lalikulu kwambiri, mu mdima wakuya kwambiri.
Mkwiyo wanu unditsalira; mafunde anu onse andimiza. Sela.
Mwachotsa abwenzi anga; mwapanga kuti andipewe. Ndatsekereredwa, ndipo sindikuthawira.
Maso anga abundirira ndi misozi. Tsiku lonse ndimakuyitanani, Yehova, ndimakweza manja anga kwa inu kupempha.
Kodi mumachita zinthu zodabwitsa kwa akufa? Kodi mizimu ya akufa idzauka ndi kukutamandani? Sela.
Kodi chikondi chanu chosasinthika chinganenedwe m'manda? Kodi kukhulupirika kwanu kunganenedwe ku malo a chiwonongeko?
Kodi kuwala kwa zochita zanu zodabwitsa kungaonedwe mu mdima? Kodi chilungamo chanu chinganenedwe m'dziko la kuyiwalika?
Yehova, ndimafuula kwa inu kuti mundithandize; m'mawa uliwonse pemphero langa limafika kwa inu.
Yehova, n'chifukwa chiyani mumandikana? N'chifukwa chiyani mumabisa nkhope yanu kwa ine?
Ndakhala wovutika ndipo ndakhala pafupi ndi imfa kuyambira ndili wamng'ono. Ndili ngati wopanda chiyembekezo, mantha anu apangitsa kuti ndikhale wodzaza ndi mantha.
Mkwiyo wanu wadutsa pa ine; mantha anu andiwononga.
Andizinga ngati chigumula tsiku lonse; andizinga kotheratu.
Mwachotsa achikondi anga ndi abwenzi anga kwa ine. Mdima ndi bwenzi langa lokha.
Ndidzayimba kosatha za chikondi chanu chosasinthika, Yehova! Pakamwa panga padzalengeza kukhulupirika kwanu kwa mibadwomibadwo.
Chikondi chanu chosasinthika chidzakhalitsa kosatha; kukhulupirika kwanu kuli kolimba ngati kumwamba.
Yehova akuti, "Ndapanga pangano ndi munthu wanga wosankhidwa. Ndalumbira kwa Davide kapolo wanga:
Ndidzakhazikitsa mbadwa zako kosatha, ndipo ndidzakhazikitsa mpando wako wachifumu mu mbadwo uliwonse." Sela.
Kumwamba kuyamika zochita zanu zodabwitsa, Yehova; mitundu yochuluka ya angelo idzayimba za kukhulupirika kwanu.
Pakuti ndani mu kumwamba angafanizidwe ndi Yehova? Ndi mngelo wamphamvu uti angafanane ndi Yehova?
Mu msonkhano wa angelo Mulungu amaopedwa kwambiri. Iye amaopsa kuposa onse omuzungulira.
Yehova, Mulungu wa Maulamuliro! Ndani ali wamphamvu ngati inu, Yehova? Mwakhulupirika kuli mozungulira inu.
Mumalamulira nyanja yodzitamandira; pamene mafunde ake amakwera, mumawatonthoza.
Munaphwanya Rahabu ndi kupha; mwabalalitsa adani anu ndi dzanja lanu lamphamvu.
Kumwamba ndi kwanu, dziko lapansi ndi lanu; mwakhazikitsa dziko ndi zonse mwa izo.
Munalenga kumpoto ndi kummwera. Tabori ndi Heremoni amayimba zatamando dzina lanu.
Mphamvu yanu ndi yaikulu! Manja anu ndi olimba; dzanja lanu lamanja ndi lokwezeka mu kupambana.
Chilungamo ndi chiweruzo ndi maziko a mpando wanu wachifumu. Chikondi chosasinthika ndi choonadi zimayenda patsogolo panu.
Wodala ndi anthu amene akudziwa kufuula mokondwera, amene amayenda mu kuwala kwa pamaso panu, Yehova.
Akukondwera mu dzina lanu tsiku lonse; mu chilungamo chanu akukwezedwa.
Pakuti inu ndinu ulemerero wa mphamvu yawo. Mu kondwerero kwanu mumakweza nyanga zathu.
Inde, chitetezo chathu ndi cha Yehova; mfumu yathu ndi ya Woyera wa Israeli.
Kalekale munalankhula mu masomphenya kwa anthu okhulupirika, kuti, "Ndapereka mphamvu kwa wamphamvu; ndakweza wosankhidwa kuchokera kwa anthu.
Ndapeza Davide kapolo wanga; ndamudoza ndi mafuta anga oyera.
Dzanja langa lidzamuthandiza nthawi zonse; mkono wanga udzamulimbitsa.
Mdani sadzamupambana; anthu oyipa sadzamuponderera.
Ndidzaphwanya adani ake pamaso pake ndi kukantha amene amada iye.
Kukhulupirika kwanga ndi chikondi chosasinthika zidzakhala naye, ndipo mu dzina langa adzakwezedwa.
Ndidzaika dzanja lake pa nyanja, ndi dzanja lake lamanja pa mitsinje.
Adzandiyitana, 'Ndinu Bambo wanga, Mulungu wanga, ndi thanthwe la chipulumutso changa.'
Ndidzamupanga kukhala mwana wanga woyamba kubadwa, mfumu yamphamvu kwambiri pa dziko lapansi.
Ndidzasunga chikondi changa chosasinthika kwa iye kosatha; pangano langa naye lidzakhalitsa.
Ndidzakhazikitsa mbadwa zake kosatha; mpando wake wachifumu udzakhalitsa monga kumwamba.
Komatu ngati ana ake adzasiya lamulo langa ndi kusatsata malamulo anga,
ngati adzaphwanya malamulo anga ndi kusasunga malamulo anga,
ndidzalanga kupanduka kwawo ndi ndodo, ndi kuchimwa kwawo ndi kukwapula.
Koma sindidzachotsa chikondi changa chosasinthika kuchokera kwa iye, kapena kusakhulupirika kwa malonjezo anga.
Ayi, sindidzaphwanya pangano langa; sindidzasintha zomwe ndinanena.
Ndalumbira kamodzi mwa kuyera kwanga, ndipo sindidzanena bodza kwa Davide:
Mbadwa zake zidzakhalitsa kosatha; mpando wake wachifumu udzakhala woyenera pamaso panga ngati dzuwa.
Udzakhazikika kosatha ngati mwezi, mboni yokhulupirika kumwamba." Sela.
Komatu inu mwakana ndi kunyalanyaza; mwakwiya ndi wodzozedwa wanu.
Mwakana pangano lanu ndi kapolo wanu; mwagwetsera korona wake mu fumbi.
Mwagwetsa makoma ake onse, ndipo mwawononga malo ake olimba.
Onse odutsa amamulanda; akhala chinthu chonyozeka kwa anansi ake.
Mwakweza dzanja lamanja la adani ake; mwapangitsa adani ake onse kukondwera.
Mwabwerera lupanga lake; simunamuchirikize kunkhondo.
Mwathetsa kuwala kwake kowala; mwagwetsa mpando wake wachifumu pansi.
Mwafupika masiku a unyamata wake; mwamuveka manyazi. Sela.
Yehova, mpaka liti? Kodi mudzabisa nkhope yanu kosatha? Kodi mkwiyo wanu udzayaka ngati moto kufikira liti?
Kumbukirani mfupi kwa moyo wanga! N'chifukwa chiyani munalenga anthu opanda phindu?
Ndani angakhale ndi moyo ndi kupewa imfa? Ndani angapulumuke ku mphamvu ya manda? Sela.
Ambuye, chikondi chanu chosasinthika chakale chili kuti, chimene munalumbira kwa Davide kuti chidzakhala chokhulupirika?
Kumbukirani, Ambuye, kunyozedwa kwa kapolo wanu, momwe ndimanyamulira m'mtima mwanga zonyodola za mitundu yochuluka,
kunyozedwa, Yehova, ndi adani anu, kunyozedwa kwa mapazi a wodzozedwa wanu.
Atamandike Yehova kosatha! Ame ndi Ame.
Ambuye, kuyambira kale lonse mwakhala malo athu okhalamo!
Mapiri asanabadwe, dziko lapansi ndi dziko zisanapangidwe, kuyambira kale lonse mpaka kale lonse, inu ndinu Mulungu.
Mumabwezera anthu ku fumbi, ponena kuti, "Bwererani ku fumbi, inu ana a anthu."
Pakuti kwa inu, zaka chikwi zili ngati tsiku limodzi lomwe lapita, kapena ngati ola la usiku.
Mumawasesa kunja monga m'tulo; ali ngati udzu umene umamera m'mawa.
M'mawa amaphuka ndi kukula; madzulo amafota ndi kuuma.
Tikuwonongeka ndi mkwiyo wanu; tikuthedwa nzeru ndi mkwiyo wanu.
Mwayika machimo athu pamaso panu, machimo athu obisika mu kuwala kwa pamaso panu.
Tikukhala masiku athu pansi pa mkwiyo wanu; tikutha zaka zathu ndi kubuula.

Tikhoza kukhala ndi moyo zaka makumi asanu ndi awiri kapena zaka makumi asanu ndi atatu ngati tikhala olimba. Komatu ngakhale zaka zathu zabwino zimadzaza ndi mavuto ndi chisoni; zimatha mwachangu, ndipo timawuluka kupita.
Ndani amazindikira mphamvu ya mkwiyo wanu? Mkwiyo wanu uli waukulu monga kuopedwa kwanu.
Tiphunzitseni kuwerenga masiku athu, kuti tikhale ndi mtima wanzeru.
Bwererani, Yehova! Mpaka liti mudzachedwa? Chitirani chifundo akapolo anu!
Tikhutiritseni m'mawa ndi chikondi chanu chosasinthika, kuti tiyimbe mokondwera ndi kusangalala masiku athu onse.
Tisangalatseni masiku ofanana ndi amene munativutitsa, ndi zaka ofanana ndi zomwe tinaona zoyipa.
Lekani akapolo anu adzaone zochita zanu zodabwitsa; lekani ana athu adzaone ulemerero wanu.
Lekani Ambuye Mulungu wathu adzakhale nafe ndi kondwerero kwake. Lekani akhazikitse ntchito ya manja athu—inde, khazikitsani ntchito ya manja athu.
Amene amakhala mu malo obisika a Wamkuludzukulu adzapeza mpumulo mu mthunzi wa Wamphamvuyonse.
Ichi ndi chimene ndinena za Yehova: Iye yekha ndi pothawira pa nga ndi malo anga otetezeka; ndiye Mulungu wanga, ndipo ndimakhulupirira mwa iye.
Pakuti adzakupulumutsani ku msampha wa mlenzi ndi ku mliri wakupha.
Adzakuphimbani ndi nthenga zake; adzakubisani mu mapiko ake. Malonjezo ake okhulupirika ndi chovala chanu chankhondo ndi chitetezo chanu.
Musaope mantha a usiku, kapena muvi umene umauluka masana,
kapena mliri umene umayenda mu mdima, kapena chiwonongeko chimene chimagwa pakati pa masana.
Anthu chikwi adzagwa pambali panu, ndipo masauzande khumi padzanja lanu lamanja, koma sichidzakufikani.
Ndi maso anu mukangoyang'ana, ndi kuona momwe anthu oyipa amalipirira.
Ngati mukhala ndi Yehova ngati pothawira panu, ngati mwapanga Wamkuludzukulu pothawira panu,
palibe choyipa chimene chidzakugwerani; palibe mliri umene udzayandikira nyumba yanu.
Pakuti adzalamula angelo ake za inu kuti akutetezeni m'njira zanu zonse.
Adzakunyamulani m'manja mwawo, kuti phazi lanu lisapunthwe pa mwala.
Mudzapondereza mkango ndi njoka pansi pa mapazi anu; mudzapondereza mwana wa mkango ndi njoka.
Yehova akuti, "Ndidzapulumutsa amene amandikonda; ndidzawateteza amene amadziwa dzina langa.
Akandiyitana, ndidzawayankha; ndidzakhala nawo pa mavuto. Ndidzawapulumutsa ndi kuwapatsa ulemu.
Ndidzawapatsa moyo wautali ndi kuwaonetsa chipulumutso changa."
Ndi chinthu chabwino kuyamika Yehova, kuyimba zatamando dzina lanu, Wamkuludzukulu.
Ndi chinthu chabwino kulengeza chikondi chanu chosasinthika m'mawa, kukhulupirika kwanu madzulo,
kuyimbidwa ndi pangwe wa zingwe khumi ndi nyimbo zochititsa chimwemwe ndi zeze.
Mwandipangitsa kukondwera ndi zochita zanu, Yehova; ndimayimba mokondwera chifukwa cha zochita za manja anu.
Zochita zanu, Yehova, ndi zazikulu chotani! Maganizo anu ndi akuya kwambiri.
Munthu wopanda nzeru sazindikira; wopusa sangamvetse zimenezi:
Ngakhale anthu oyipa akula ngati udzu, ndipo onse ochita zoyipa akupita patsogolo, adzawonongedwa kosatha.
Koma inu, Yehova, ndinu okwezedwa kosatha.
Adani anu, Yehova, taonani momwe adani anu adzaonongekera; onse ochita zoyipa adzabalalitsidwa.
Koma mwakweza nyanga yanga ngati ya njati; mwandithirira mafuta abwino.
Maso anga aona kugonjetsedwa kwa adani anga; makutu anga amva za chionongeko cha amene anandiukira.
Olungama adzakula ngati mtengo wa kanjedza; adzakhala ngati mkungudza wa Lebanoni.
Pakuti abzalidwa mu nyumba ya Yehova, adzakula mu mabwalo a Mulungu wathu.
Ngakhale mu ukalamba adzapereka zipatso; adzakhala atsopano ndi obiriwira.
Adzalengeza kuti, "Yehova ali wolungama! Iye ndi thanthwe langa! Mwa iye mulibe choipa!"
Yehova ndi Mfumu! Iye wavekedwa ulemerero. Ndithudi, Yehova wavekedwa ulemerero ndi kudzizinga ndi mphamvu. Dziko lapansi likhazikika ndipo silingagwedezeke.
Mpando wanu wachifumu, Yehova, wakhazikika kuyambira kale lonse. Inu nokha mulipo kuyambira kale lonse.
Mitsinje yakwera, Yehova. Mitsinje yakweza phokoso lake; mitsinje yakweza mafunde ake.
Koma woposa phokoso la madzi ochuluka, woposa mafunde amphamvu a nyanja, Yehova kumwamba ndi wamphamvu kwambiri.
Malamulo anu ndi okhulupirika, Yehova; nyumba yanu idzakhala yoyera kosatha.
Yehova, Mulungu wa kubwezera, Mulungu wa kubwezera, onetsani inu nokha!
Dzukani, woweruza wa dziko lapansi; lipirani odzitamandira zomwe akuyenera.
Mpaka liti, Yehova, mpaka liti anthu oyipa adzakondwere?
Mpaka liti adzayankhula mwa kunyada? Mpaka liti onse ochita zoyipa adzadzitamandira?
Akuponderera anthu anu, Yehova, akuvutitsa amene ndi anu.
Akupha akazi amasiye ndi alendo, ndipo akupha amasiye.
Akuti, "Yehova sakuona; Mulungu wa Yakobo sazindikira."
Zindikirani, anthu opusa! Mudzazindikira liti, opusa?
Iye amene anapanga makutu—kodi sangamve? Iye amene anapanga maso—kodi sangaone?
Kodi amene amalanga mitundu sangadzudzule? Iye amaphunzitsa anthu—kodi alibe nzeru?
Yehova amadziwa maganizo a anthu kuti ali ngati mphepo.
Wodala ndi munthu amene mumamulanga, Yehova, amene mumamuphunzitsa lamulo lanu.
Mumawapatsa mpumulo pa masiku a mavuto, mpaka dzenje likumbidwa kwa anthu oyipa.
Yehova sadzasiya anthu ake; sadzakana cholowa chake.
Chiweruzo chidzabwerera kwa olungama, ndipo onse oyera mtima adzachita zachilungamo.
Ndani adzandichirikiza pa anthu oyipa? Ndani adzandichirikiza pa ochita zoyipa?
Yehova akadapanda kundithandiza, ndikadakhala mu chete cha imfa msanga.
Pamene ndinati, "Phazi langa likuterera," chikondi chanu chosasinthika, Yehova, chinandichirikiza.
Pamene maganizo anga andichuluka, kondwerero kwanu kunditonthoza ndi kundipatsa chimwemwe.
Kodi mungalumikizane ndi olamulira oyipa amene amabweretsa kuvutika kupyolera mu malamulo opanda chilungamo?
Akusonkhana motsutsana ndi olungama; akupereka chiweruzo cha imfa pa anthu osalakwa.
Koma Yehova ndi malo anga otetezeka, ndipo Mulungu wanga ndi thanthwe limene ndingathawire.
Mulungu adzawalipira chifukwa cha machimo awo; adzawawononga chifukwa cha zoyipa zawo. Yehova Mulungu wathu adzawawononga.
Bwerani, tiyimbe mokondwera kwa Yehova! Tifuule mokondwera kwa thanthwe la chipulumutso chathu.
Tibwere pamaso pake ndi yamiko; tiyimbe nyimbo zatamando kwa iye.
Pakuti Yehova ndi Mulungu wamkulu, mfumu yaikulu kuposa milungu yonse.
M'manja mwake muli kuya kwa dziko lapansi, ndi nsonga za mapiri ndi zake.
Nyanja ndi yake, pakuti anaipanga; manja ake anapanga dziko louma.
Bwerani, tipembedze ndi kugwadira; tigwadire pansi pamaso pa Yehova mlengi wathu,
pakuti iye ndi Mulungu wathu. Ife ndi anthu omwe amayang'anira, gulu la nkhosa zomwe amayang'anira. Ngati lero mungamve mawu ake!
Yehova akuti, "Musaumitse mitima yanu monga ku Meriba, monga tsiku ku Masa m'chipululu,
kumene makolo anu anandiyesa; ananditsutsa ngakhale anaona zochita zanga.
Kwa zaka makumi anayi ndinakhala wokwiya ndi mbadwo umenewu, ndipo ndinati, 'Mitima yawo imapatuka kuchoka kwa ine. Sazindikira njira zanga.'
Choncho ndinalumbira mu mkwiyo wanga, 'Sadzalowa mu malo a mpumulo wanga.'"
Imbirani Yehova nyimbo yatsopano! Imbirani Yehova, dziko lonse lapansi.
Imbirani Yehova; tamandani dzina lake. Lengezani uthenga wabwino wa chipulumutso chake tsiku lililonse.
Lengezani ulemerero wake pakati pa mitundu; nenani za zochita zake zodabwitsa pakati pa anthu.
Pakuti Yehova ndi waukulu! Iye ndi woyenera kutamandidwa kwambiri! Iye ayenera kuopedwa kuposa milungu yonse.
Milungu ya mitundu ina ndi mafano chabe, koma Yehova analenga kumwamba!
Ulemu ndi ulemerero zili pamaso pake; mphamvu ndi kukongola zili mu kachisi wake.
Patsani Yehova, mabanja onse a anthu, patsani Yehova ulemerero ndi mphamvu.
Patsani Yehova ulemu umene umuyenera dzina lake. Bweretsani nsembe yanu ndi kulowa mu mabwalo ake.
Pembedzani Yehova mu kukongola kwa kuyera kwake; lekani dziko lonse lapansi linjenjemere pamaso pake.
Lengezani pakati pa mitundu kuti, "Yehova ndi Mfumu! Dziko lapansi likhazikika ndipo silingagwedezeke. Adzaweruza anthu mwa chilungamo."
Lekani kumwamba kukondwere ndi dziko lapansi likondwere! Lekani nyanja ndi zonse zomwe zili m'menemo zifuule!
Lekani minda ndi zonse zili m'menemo zifuule mokondwera! Lekani mitengo ya nkhalango iyimbe matamando
pamaso pa Yehova, pakuti akubwera! Akubwera kuti aweruze dziko lapansi. Adzaweruza dziko mwa chilungamo, ndi mitundu ya anthu mu choonadi chake.
Yehova ndi Mfumu! Lekani dziko lapansi likondwere! Lekani malo akutali okhala m'nyanja akondwere.
Mitambo yakuda ndi mdima zamzungulira. Chilungamo ndi chiweruzo ndi maziko a mpando wake wachifumu.
Moto umayenda patsogolo pake ndi kunyeketsa adani ake mozungulira.
Mphenzi yake imawunikira dziko lapansi; dziko lapansi limaona ndi kunjenjemera.
Mapiri amasungunuka ngati sera pamaso pa Yehova, pamaso pa Ambuye wa dziko lonse lapansi.
Kumwamba kumalengeza chilungamo chake; mitundu yonse imaona ulemerero wake.
Onse opembedza mafano achite manyazi—amene amadzitamandira ndi milungu yopanda phindu—pakuti milungu yonse igwadira pamaso pake.
Ziyoni inamva ndipo inakondwera, ndipo midzi yonse ya Yuda inakondwera chifukwa cha chiweruzo chanu, Yehova.
Pakuti inu, Yehova, ndinu wokwezedwa pa dziko lonse lapansi; mukukwezedwa kwambiri kuposa milungu yonse.
Inu amene mumakonda Yehova, dani choipa! Iye amasunga miyoyo ya okhulupirika ake ndi kuwapulumutsa m'manja mwa anthu oyipa.
Kuwala kumawalira olungama, ndi chimwemwe kwa amene mtima wawo uli wolungama.
Lekani onse olungama akondwere mwa Yehova; tamandani dzina lake loyera!
